title: FOTO: Figure-Level Semantic Search for Astronomy
background_knowledge: 在现代天文学研究中，学术文献的数量呈爆炸式增长，研究人员高度依赖文献检索系统（如NASA ADS或Semantic Scholar等）来获取所需信息。然而，传统的文献搜索引擎主要基于纯文本（如标题、摘要和正文文本）进行索引。在天文学论文中，大量的核心科学数据、物理规律和观测结果（如光谱图、光变曲线、星系形态图像、参数相关性散点图等）高度浓缩在图表中。由于缺乏针对“图表级别”的语义检索工具，研究人员无法仅凭对图表内容的描述来直接检索并定位到具体的图表。近年来，随着自然语言处理（NLP）和大规模预训练模型技术的发展，对文献中的图表说明文字（Caption）进行深度语义嵌入与检索，成为解决这一痛点、提升天文学术信息获取效率的新兴研究方向。
contribution: 本文开发并介绍了一款名为FOTO的天文学图表级语义检索工具，旨在通过文本描述直接搜索论文图表。该工具对53,839篇同行评审的天体物理学论文中的482,750个图表及其说明进行了索引。FOTO利用一个1.1亿参数的本地开源模型进行文本嵌入，并仅在检索出的候选子集上应用大语言模型（LLM）来验证图表的相关性，从而有效避免了LLM凭空捏造虚假引用的“幻觉”问题。性能测试表明，在更严格的“图表级”检索标准下，FOTO的召回率（Recall@20）达到29%至79%，显著优于Pathfinder（6%-20%）和Semantic Scholar（8%-16%）在更宽松的“论文级”标准下的表现，且效果超越了付费嵌入API。此外，通过对候选列表进行重排，检索准确度得到大幅提升，且研究证实开源模型在图表验证任务上的表现已持平或超越了付费LLM模型。
summary: Astronomy papers carry much of their content in figures, but literature search indexes text, so there is no way to find a plot by describing what it shows. We present FOTO, a figure-level search tool over 482,750 captions from 53,839 peer-reviewed astro-ph papers. Each figure is indexed once by its title and caption, embedded with a 110M-parameter open model that runs locally, and a large language model is applied only to the retrieved shortlist, where it verifies real figures rather than generating references to ones that do not exist. Held to the harder figure-level criterion, FOTO recovers the target for 29 to 79% of queries at recall 20 depending on register, against 6 to 20% for Pathfinder and 8 to 16% for Semantic Scholar on the easier paper-level criterion, and it beats the paid embedding API it replaced. Reranking the shortlist then raises recall at 1 from 0.667 to 0.875 on detailed queries and from 0.071 to 0.571 on vague ones. Openly available models match or beat paid LLM models for verification

title: A tidal disruption event in a quasar at redshift 7.19
background_knowledge: 潮汐撕裂事件（Tidal Disruption Event, TDE）是指当一颗恒星轨道过于靠近中心超大质量黑洞时，被黑洞的强大潮汐力撕裂并部分吸积，从而在短时间内释放出巨大能量的瞬变天文现象。其典型光变曲线表现为快速上升及随后的 $t^{-5/3}$ 幂律衰减。类星体（Quasar）则是由超大质量黑洞持续吸积物质驱动的极其明亮的活动星系核（AGN）。在宇宙极早期（例如红移 z>7，即大爆炸后约7亿年），超大质量黑洞如何在短时间内快速积累质量是天体物理学的重大未解之谜之一。在这些早期的高质量黑洞周围通常伴随着极其致密的星群和富含尘埃的核区环境，这为TDE的发生提供了极佳条件。然而，受限于极远的距离和观测设备的灵敏度，在高红移类星体中直接探测到TDE极具挑战性。通过多波段、长基线的时域观测捕捉此类事件，能够为我们研究早期宇宙黑洞的阵发性（episodic）吸积物理、宽线区（BLR）的形成以及星系核区的尘埃分布提供独一无二的物理探针。
contribution: 本文报告了在红移 z=7.19 的红色类星体 GNz7q（宿主为致密尘埃星暴星系，中心黑洞质量约 3×10^7 M_⊙）中发现的一个长寿命核区瞬变源。通过综合HST、Spitzer和JWST长达二十多年的观测数据，研究发现该源在静止系紫外波段表现出快速变亮和持续约2年（静止系）的光滑衰减，其极端变异性显著高于典型类星体随机光变，且演化特征及能量学排除了超亮超新星的可能。最佳物理模型表明，这属于一次高能的潮汐撕裂事件（TDE），一颗几倍太阳质量的恒星被撕裂，产生了峰值热辐射光度约 3×10^45 erg/s、总辐射能量约 1.5×10^53 erg 的耀发，是已知能量最高的TDE之一。同时，JWST/NIRSpec光谱观测到了红移的极端宽巴耳末发射线，指示了瞬态的非维里化宽线区；JWST/MIRI揭示了来自亚秒差距尺度、温度约1500 K的尘埃延迟中红外辐射（尘埃回声）。该工作首次在时域层面上展现了宇宙大爆炸后7亿年时黑洞的阵发性物质吸积过程及其核区尘埃环境，并突出了未来Roman、Euclid等广域巡天设备在发现此类高红移瞬变源方面的巨大潜力。
summary: We report a long-lived nuclear transient in GNz7q, a red quasar at $z=7.19$ powered by a $\sim3\times10^{7}\,M_\odot$ black hole and hosted by a compact, dusty starburst galaxy. The transient was identified in more than two decades of imaging with HST, Spitzer, and JWST. After a rapid rise, the source faded smoothly by $Δm\simeq1.1$ mag in the rest-frame ultraviolet over $\sim2$ rest-frame yr, with coherent, wavelength-dependent evolution across 1--5 $μ$m that places GNz7q above the 99.9th percentile of the SDSS quasar variability distribution and is absent at $z\gtrsim5$. The duration and energetics disfavor superluminous supernovae, and stochastic quasar variability reproduces the multi-band evolution with a probability of $\lesssim10^{-5}$. A panchromatic model combining a thermal continuum with a $t^{-5/3}$ decline reproduces the light curves, yielding a peak bolometric luminosity of $\simeq3\times10^{45}$ erg s$^{-1}$ and a radiated energy of $\simeq1.5\times10^{53}$ erg, which imply the tidal disruption of a star of a few solar masses and place the event among the most energetic tidal disruption events (TDEs) known. A redshifted, extremely broad Balmer-line component in independent JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy is consistent with a transient, non-virialized broad-line region. JWST/MIRI photometry further reveals delayed mid-infrared emission from $\simeq1500$ K dust at a sub-parsec radius, consistent with a dust echo of the flare. The relatively low black-hole mass and dense star-forming nucleus of GNz7q are conditions under which TDEs are expected to be most efficient. These observations provide a time-domain view of episodic black-hole fueling and its dusty nuclear environment 700 million years after the Big Bang. Wide-field surveys with Roman and Euclid in the near-infrared, complemented by LSST at lower redshifts, may uncover such transients in large numbers.

title: SN Helios: A Multiply Imaged Type II Supernova Opening Time-Delay Cosmography beyond redshift of 3
background_knowledge: 引力透镜效应是指大质量天体（如星系或星系团）的引力场使得背景光源发出的光线发生弯曲的现象。当背景光源是超新星等瞬变天体时，强引力透镜效应不仅能大幅放大其观测亮度，还可能产生同一天体的多重图像。由于光线沿着不同路径传播时的几何距离不同，且穿越的引力势阱深度各异，这些多重图像到达地球的时间会存在差值（即时间延迟）。时间延迟宇宙学（Time-Delay Cosmography）通过精确测量这一延迟，并结合透镜天体的质量模型，可以用来独立测量哈勃常数（H_0）等宇宙学参数，是当前检验标准宇宙学模型和缓解“哈勃张力”的重要独立手段。然而，受限于探测深度与概率，高红移（z>3）的多重成像透镜超新星样本极为罕见。
contribution: 本文报告了利用JWST发现在星系团RXC J0018.5+1626背后红移 z=3.34 处的多重成像强引力透镜II型超新星 SN Helios。光谱观测确认了其带有P-Cygni吸收轮廓的宽Hα发射线，确立了其氢富集的光球层特性。透镜模型显示当前图像被放大了约10-20倍，并预测在2-6年内将出现另一重图像，为利用高红移源进行时间延迟宇宙学测量提供了罕见契机。此外，其极暗的宿主星系在极深观测下仍未被探测到，支持了超微弱星系中具有较高核坍缩超新星发生率的观点；若无多历元观测，该天体极易被误认为 z≈16 的莱曼断裂星系，其光谱因此为未来高红移候选体的筛选提供了重要的经验SED剔除模板。
summary: We report the discovery and spectroscopic confirmation of SN Helios, a strongly lensed, multiply imaged Type II supernova (SN) at $z=3.34$ behind the galaxy cluster RXC J0018.5+1626. The transient was identified as a red F150W-dropout source (F277W = 26.1 mag) in JWST/NIRCam imaging taken on 2026 July 3 for the VENUS survey, with no counterpart in 2024 December imaging. Director's Discretionary Time observations on 2026 August 17 added second-epoch NIRCam imaging and a deep NIRSpec prism spectrum. The spectrum shows a strong, spectrally resolved H$α$ emission line (FWHM $\approx 7900$ km/s) with a P-Cygni absorption blueshifted by 8800 km/s, together with corresponding H$β$ and He I $λ$10830 features, establishing a hydrogen-rich photosphere at $z=3.34$. Template fits classify SN Helios as a Type II SN, and light-curve comparisons with well-studied local SNe II yield a phase of $27.5\pm2.8$ rest-frame days past B-band maximum. Independent cluster lens models magnify the observed image by $μ\approx 10$-20 and predict another image within $\simeq 2$-6 yr, offering a rare opportunity for a time-delay measurement of $H_{0}$ with a source at $z>3$. The host galaxy is undetected in deep rest-frame ultraviolet and optical imaging, in emission lines, and in ALMA 2 mm dust continuum, leaving a heavily obscured counterpart unlikely. Its de-lensed $M_{\rm UV}\gtrsim -13$ places it far below blank-field limits and adds support to an elevated core-collapse rate per unit star formation in ultra-faint galaxies. Without the multi-epoch data, SN Helios would masquerade as a convincing $z\approx 16$ Lyman-break galaxy, with galaxy-template fits strongly disfavoring any low-redshift solution even with multiple medium bands. Its spectrum thus provides an empirical SED template with which high-redshift searches can vet similar dropout candidates.

title: Saturation Mechanism of Cosmic Ray Streaming Instabilities with a Shell Distribution
background_knowledge: 宇宙线（Cosmic Rays, CRs）是充满在星系和星系团空间中的高能带电粒子。当宇宙线在背景等离子体中以超过阿尔芬速度的相对速度漂移（streaming）时，会共振激发阿尔芬波，引发“宇宙线流不稳定性”（Streaming Instability）。这些被激发的波反过来会强烈散射宇宙线，限制其传输速度，并将其动量和能量转移给背景等离子体。这一过程在驱动星系风、调节星系恒星形成以及加热星系团核心冷却流中扮演着关键角色。为了在星系形成和星际介质的宏观流体模拟中正确描述宇宙线的输运，必须准确理解流不稳定性的非线性饱和机制。传统宇宙线输运模型中普遍假设，非线性朗道阻尼（Nonlinear Landau Damping, NLLD）是限制波增长并决定饱和水平的主导机制。
contribution: 本文利用全动力学细胞内粒子（PIC）和流体-PIC（FPIC）模拟，研究了具有壳层动量分布的宇宙线流不稳定性的非线性饱和机制。研究发现，在模拟参数下（阿尔芬速度 v_A=0.01c，密度比 n_CR/n_i=0.01），不稳定性的饱和是通过围绕受激阿尔芬波的回旋相位聚束（gyro-phase bunching）实现的，而非由非线性朗道阻尼（NLLD）主导。即使在完全排除了NLLD效应的理想FPIC模拟中，宇宙线离子在阿尔芬波参考系下也能完全各向同性化，且饱和振幅在模拟区域扩大十倍时保持不变，证明该饱和机制是纯局域的。这一结论挑战了当前星系形成和星际介质模拟中构建宇宙线输运模型时普遍采用的NLLD主导假设。
summary: Cosmic rays (CRs) drive galactic winds and regulate galaxy growth while contributing to heating the central cooling plasma in dense galaxy clusters, making the nonlinear saturation of the instabilities that govern their transport a problem of central importance in astrophysics. Using fully kinetic particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations, we find that the streaming instability driven by CRs with a shell momentum distribution saturates through gyro-phase bunching around driven Alfvén waves. Fluid-PIC (FPIC) simulations with both ideal and Landau closures reproduce the PIC saturation amplitude, and the same gyro-phase bunching mechanism, indicating that nonlinear Landau damping (NLLD) does not determine the saturation level at our simulation parameters ($v_{\rm A} = 0.01c$, $n_{\rm CR}/n_i = 0.01$). Notably, the CR ions fully isotropize in the Alfvén-wave frame in all simulations, including the FPIC run with an ideal closure in which NLLD is entirely absent, showing that this isotropization does not require NLLD. We additionally confirm, using the FPIC ideal closure, that this saturation amplitude is unchanged across a tenfold increase in domain size, indicating that the mechanism is local rather than dependent on domain-scale processes. Together, these results indicate that, at least in this regime, NLLD is not the dominant saturation mechanism for the CR streaming instability, in tension with common assumptions built into CR transport models used in galaxy formation and interstellar medium simulations. Whether this conclusion extends to the lower CR densities and Alfvén speeds characteristic of the interstellar medium remains an open question that we address in an upcoming work.

title: Observational constraints on scalar-vector-tensor dark energy with phantom-divide crossing
background_knowledge: 宇宙加速膨胀通常由被称为“暗能量”的神秘组分驱动。在标准宇宙学模型（ΛCDM）中，暗能量被视为状态方程参数 w = -1 的宇宙学常数。然而，动力学暗能量模型允许 w 随时间演化。当 w < -1 时，暗能量被称为“幽灵”（phantom）暗能量。状态方程从一侧穿越 w = -1 的过程被称为“幽灵分界线穿越”（phantom-divide crossing）。在标准的单一标量场理论中，实现这种穿越往往会遭遇理论上的不稳定性（如鬼场问题），而标量-矢量-张量（SVT）等更复杂的引力或场论模型则能够提供物理上稳定的穿越机制。为了检验这些模型，宇宙学家通常会结合超新星（SNe）、重子声学振荡（BAO）、宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）以及红移空间畸变（RSD）等大尺度结构观测数据进行严格的参数限制。
contribution: 本文利用多项最新宇宙学观测数据（包括DES Y5超新星、DESI DR2重子声学振荡、CMB压缩信息以及Gold-2017红移空间畸变RSD数据）对标量-矢量-张量（SVT）暗能量模型进行了观测限制。在该模型中，矢量场在早期驱使暗能量状态方程参数低于-1，随后标量场使其穿越-1并在当今演化至-1以上。研究表明，背景数据后验显著支持这种穿越历史，且最佳拟合结果优于平坦的ΛCDM模型；结合RSD数据的分析不仅保留了该演化特征、限制了成团性振幅，还进一步增加了对方向性穿越准则的后验支持。贝叶斯因子计算显示，SVT模型总体上优于ΛCDM模型，证实了当前的宇宙膨胀与结构增长数据与SVT模型中稳定的幽灵分界线动态穿越现象高度一致。
summary: We constrain a scalar-vector-tensor (SVT) dark-energy model in which the vector sector drives the dark-energy equation of state below $-1$ at earlier times, while a canonical scalar field subsequently drives it across $-1$ toward a present-day value above $-1$. We confront the model with DES Year 5 supernovae, DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations, and compressed cosmic microwave background information, and then include Gold-2017 redshift-space-distortion (RSD) measurements to probe structure growth. The background posterior assigns substantial weight to crossing histories and gives a better best fit than the flat $Λ$-cold-dark-matter ($Λ$CDM) model. The RSD analysis preserves this qualitative background evolution, constrains the clustering amplitude, and increases the posterior support for the directional crossing criterion. Since the growth analysis also imposes additional perturbative support conditions, this increase cannot be attributed to the RSD likelihood alone. Matched PolyChord calculations give Bayes factors larger than unity for SVT relative to $Λ$CDM under both prior-volume conventions considered here. The quantitative Bayes factor depends on the prior normalization assigned to the regular radiation-era branch and is larger in the RSD analysis under either convention. Overall, current expansion and structure-growth data are consistent with a stable dynamical crossing of the phantom divide in the SVT model.

title: Probing the cosmic web with fast radio bursts: II. Scintillation
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构（Cosmic Web）由暗物质主导，气体在引力作用下坍缩形成纤维状结构（Filaments）、面状结构（Sheets）以及星系晕。在这些结构及其星系周围介质（CGM）中，激波加热与冷却碎裂过程会产生多相气体，包括致密、低温（约10^4 K）的小尺度云团。快速射电暴（FRB）是极高亮度的毫秒级河外射电瞬变源，其发出的射电波在穿越宇宙空间时，会受到沿线电离等离子体（如星系际和星系周围介质中的多相结构）的色散和闪烁（Scintillation）效应影响。闪烁效应源于无线电波穿过湍流等离子体时的干涉，因此FRB的闪烁特征成为了探测宇宙网中小尺度气体结构、密度波动以及湍流特性的强大工具。
contribution: 本文研究了宇宙网天体（包含纤维带、面状结构和星系周围介质）中致密低温小尺度云团对FRB传播的闪烁效应的影响。研究发现，尽管直接观测到此类冷云团的概率较小且主要局限于高红移，但这些宇宙网等离子体屏能够有效抑制由银河系星际介质引起的闪烁，从而提供了一种全新的探测手段。具体而言，纤维带和面状结构能分别抑制红移 z ≳ 2 和 3 的FRB的银河系闪烁，而CGM中的冷湍流云团可通过红移低至 z ~ 0.5 的FRB进行探测，进而对极低的体积填充因子（如 z ≳ 2 时 f_v ≳ 10^-5）给出严格限制。论文还定量预测了能够抑制银河系闪烁的FRB比例与平均河外色散量的关系，为未来大样本FRB观测限制宇宙网冷云团的密度、尺寸、体积填充因子及湍流特性提供了可检验的理论预言。
summary: We consider the formation of multiphase gas in cosmic web objects (CWOs) through cooling and fragmentation within the shock-heated medium of cosmic sheets and filaments, and the circumgalactic medium (CGM) of haloes. This leads to dense, cool ($\sim10^{4}\,\mathrm{K}$), small-scale cloudlets in pressure equilibrium with their surroundings. Such ionized overdensities can affect the propagation of radio waves emitted by fast radio bursts (FRBs), allowing us to probe the small-scale structure in CWOs by examining their impact on the scintillation pattern of the observed FRB flux. While we find that the probability of encountering a high-temperature filament or sheet with cold cloudlets is rather small and usually confined to high redshifts, the expected high rates of FRBs may still permit detection through scintillation along rare sightlines. We suggest scintillation from the Milky Way (MW) interstellar medium as a promising probe: CWO plasma screens can suppress it, placing constraints on their cold-gas properties. Filaments and sheets can suppress MW scintillation from sources at $z_\mathrm{S}\gtrsim2$ and $3$, respectively, while cold and turbulent cloudlets in the CGM can be probed by sources at redshifts as low as $z_\mathrm{S}\sim0.5$, constraining remarkably low volume-filling fractions, $f_\mathrm{v}$ (e.g. $f_\mathrm{v}\gtrsim10^{-5}$ for $z_\mathrm{S}\gtrsim2$). To provide testable predictions, we estimate the fraction of FRBs expected to encounter CWOs that may suppress MW scintillation below a given frequency, and express this as a function of the average extragalactic dispersion measure. Future FRB samples could map these constraints onto bounds on the existence and properties of cloudlets in CWOs, such as their density, size, $f_\mathrm{v}$, and turbulence.

title: Simulating tidal disruption events in nuclear star clusters
background_knowledge: 在许多星系的中心，通常同时存在超大质量黑洞（SMBH）和极端致密的核星团（NSC）。在这种复杂的引力动力学环境中，当恒星的轨道极为靠近中心黑洞并跨越所谓的潮汐半径时，黑洞强大的潮汐力会超过恒星的自引力，从而将恒星撕裂，这一过程被称为潮汐瓦解事件（Tidal Disruption Event, TDE）。瓦解后的恒星碎片有一部分会被黑洞吸积并产生强烈的高能辐射，这在缺乏自由气体的星系中是超大质量黑洞质量增长的重要机制。在理论计算与N体模拟中，如何准确描述恒星落入“损失锥”（Loss-cone）后的动力学演化，尤其是摒弃100%吸积的简单假设，根据恒星轨道的偏心率和穿透深度来量化黑洞实际吸积的碎片质量比例（即部分吸积），是完善黑洞演化和TDE物理图像的关键前沿课题。
contribution: 该研究通过针对包含中心超大质量黑洞的核星团进行完全自洽的直接N体动力学模拟，提出并验证了一种改进的TDE部分质量吸积理论模型。与传统假设恒星质量被完全吸积的固定半径模型不同，新模型将黑洞吸积的碎片质量与瓦解恒星的轨道偏心率和穿透因子相关联。研究发现：绝大多数主序星的TDE轨道呈边缘偏心或边缘双曲线形态，约向黑洞贡献了恒星总质量的一半，这与近期的流体力学模拟高度吻合；TDE驱动的吸积率表现为早期快速达峰后迅速衰减，且初始质量越大的黑洞由于损失锥被快速消耗且恒星补充效率低下，其吸积率衰减得更为剧烈。
summary:
Context. Nuclear star clusters (NSCs) and supermassive black holes (SMBHs) often coexist at the centers of galaxies, engaging in complex dynamical interactions that influence SMBH growth. Stars that approach the SMBH too closely are tidally disrupted, and a fraction of their debris is accreted onto the black hole. Such events may contribute to SMBH growth in gas-deficient galaxies.
  Aims. Our work aims to improve the theoretical framework for understanding the mass accretion of stellar debris following tidal disruption events (TDEs) through numerical simulations. We perform direct N-body simulations of an NSC with a central SMBH embedded in a fully self-consistent dynamical model to test a new TDE accretion prescription in a set of pilot simulations.
  Methods. The previous TDE prescription used a fixed accretion radius and assumed that the entire stellar mass was accreted after disruption. In the new partial-mass accretion model, the mass added to the SMBH depends on the orbital eccentricity and penetration factor of the disrupted star.
  Results. We find that most TDEs involving main-sequence stars are marginally eccentric or marginally hyperbolic and contribute approximately half of the stellar mass to SMBH growth, consistent with recent hydrodynamical simulations. In all simulated models, the TDE-driven mass accretion rate exhibits an early peak followed by a rapid decline. Models with higher initial SMBH masses exhibit a faster decline in the accretion rate, consistent with more rapid loss-cone depletion and inefficient replenishment

title: Sub-Horizon and Quasi-Static Approximations in Interacting Dark Sector Models Involving Scalar Field Dark Energy
background_knowledge: 在现代标准宇宙学模型（ΛCDM）中，暗物质和暗能量占据了宇宙总能量密度的绝大部分。为了解释暗能量的动力学演化，物理学家引入了标量场暗能量模型（如精质 quintessence 和幽灵 phantom）。进一步地，考虑到暗物质与暗能量可能存在未知的非引力耦合，研究者提出了“相互作用暗区模型”（Interacting Dark Sector）。在研究这些模型下的大尺度结构形成时，通常需要求解复杂的广义相对论线性微扰方程。为简化计算，特别是在 N 体模拟和流体动力学模拟中，研究人员常在小于宇宙视界的尺度上采用次视界近似（SHA）和准静态近似（QSA），将相对论方程退化为牛顿流体方程。然而，这些近似在具有相互作用的暗能量模型中是否依然精确，直接关系到理论预测与未来高精度大尺度结构观测对比的可靠性。
contribution: 本文系统检验了次视界近似（SHA）和准静态近似（QSA）在相互作用标量场暗能量模型（包含精质和幽灵场）处理线性物质微扰时的有效性。研究发现，随着暗区相互作用强度的增加及空间尺度的增大，SHA 的精度显著下降，且无法完全恢复标准牛顿流体方程；相比之下，QSA 能提供更接近全相对论演化的描述。研究指出，在大型宇宙学模拟所涉及的尺度上，使用 SHA 带来的理论偏差可达百分之几，这证明不能仅凭次视界条件就假定 SHA 有效。该工作强调了在将相互作用暗能量模型应用于大体积结构形成模拟及高精度观测对比前，必须对近似方法进行严格的基准测试。
summary: We investigate the validity of the sub-horizon approximation (SHA) and quasi-static approximation (QSA) for linear matter perturbations in interacting scalar-field dark-energy models. We consider both quintessence and phantom scalar fields and derive their full relativistic perturbation evolution to compare with the corresponding SHA and QSA solutions. We find that, while the SHA reproduces the full evolution with percent-level accuracy for non-interacting and weakly interacting models on sufficiently sub-horizon scales, its accuracy progressively deteriorates with increasing interaction strength and towards larger scales. Moreover, unlike in $Λ$CDM and non-interacting scalar-field models, applying the SHA to interacting models does not fully recover the standard Newtonian fluid equations. The QSA generally provides a closer description of the full relativistic evolution than the SHA over the scales considered. By comparing the scalar-field model with $Λ$CDM using the full relativistic equations and, separately, using the SHA system, we evaluated whether the SHA is capable of capturing the full extent of the physical differences introduced by the alternative model. We find that the difference between these two comparisons becomes increasingly important for stronger interactions and smaller wavenumbers. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting differences can reach several percent on scales accessible to large-volume hydrodynamical simulations, implying that the validity of the SHA cannot be assumed solely from the sub-horizon condition. Our results highlight the need to benchmark the approximation over the relevant interaction parameter and wavenumber ranges before employing interacting-dark-energy models in large-volume structure-formation simulations and precision comparisons with large-scale-structure observations.

title: A Self-Consistent Jeans Analysis of the Milky Way Rotation Curve
background_knowledge: 星系旋转曲线（即恒星或气体的旋转速度随距离星系中心半径变化的曲线）是测量星系总质量分布（特别是暗物质晕）的核心工具。对于银河系，天文学家通常利用恒星等运动学示踪天体，通过金斯方程（Jeans equation）将它们的空间密度分布和速度矩与底层的引力势场联系起来。传统理论认为，受巨大暗物质晕的影响，星系外围的旋转曲线应保持平坦；然而近期观测表明银河系外围的旋转曲线可能呈下降趋势。这种下降的真实性及其物理学解释高度依赖于复杂的分析细节，包括示踪样本的选择、密度剖面的假设、金斯方程中速度梯度项的处理，以及外盘中非轴对称扰动带来的系统误差。
contribution: 本文对银河系旋转曲线进行了更为自洽的金斯分析，以验证在修正主要系统误差后外盘旋转曲线的下降趋势是否依然存在。研究团队构建了一个运动学均匀的盘星示踪样本，并直接利用该样本提取密度剖面（发现在12.5 < R < 21 kpc范围内符合双指数分布），而非采用外部标泽长度。在严格处理了包含交叉项的金斯方程及外盘子结构的运动学差异后，研究确认银河系旋转曲线在内盘平坦，但在大半径处（R ≳ 16 kpc）呈现与开普勒衰减一致的下降趋势。据此模型推算，银河系的外推总动力学质量约为 2.01(+0.10/-0.08)×10^11 太阳质量。
summary: Jeans-based measurements of the Milky Way (MW) rotation curve (RC) have revealed a declining outer RC. The interpretation, however, depends sensitively on the tracer selection, the tracer density profile, gradient terms in the Jeans equation, and non-axisymmetric perturbations in the outer disk. We present a more self-consistent Jeans analysis of the MW RC and reassess whether the outer decline remains after a revised treatment of the main Jeans terms and their associated systematic uncertainties, including those related to non-axisymmetric perturbations. We select a kinematically homogeneous disk tracer sample designed to retain stars on nearly circular disk orbits, removing only 12\% of the original sample. We estimate the tracer density profile from the same stars used for the kinematic moments, rather than adopting an external scale length. We find that the tracer density profile is better described by a double exponential over the validated range 12.5 < R < 21 kpc. We also assess the main systematic uncertainties associated with the fiducial Jeans equation terms, including the often neglected cross term, and account for different rotational velocities in the outer disk substructures. The derived RC remains nearly flat in the inner disk and declines at large radii. Over the adopted outer interval, $R\gtrsim16\,\mathrm{kpc}$, the RC slope is consistent with a Keplerian decline even after accounting for the systematic uncertainties. The corresponding mass modeling gives an extrapolated dynamical mass of $2.01^{+0.10}_{-0.08}\times10^{11}\,M_\odot$.

title: Near-infrared spectra of chemically peculiar stars and applications to kilonova spectra
background_knowledge: 千新星（Kilonova）是双中子星或中子星-黑洞并合事件中产生的光学-红外暂现源，其辐射能量主要来自快中子俘获过程（r-过程）新合成的富中子重元素发生放射性衰变时的加热。千新星光谱是探究宇宙中重元素（特别是镧系元素）起源的核心观测途径，也是多信使天文学的重要观测基石。然而，由于重元素在近红外波段的原子数据极度匮乏且能级结构非常复杂，直接在千新星光谱中证认具体元素面临极大挑战。化学奇特星（Chemically peculiar stars）因其大气中特定的重元素丰度异常偏高，为研究重元素在近红外波段的强跃迁线提供了一个理想的“天然实验室”，有助于填补原子数据的空白并辅助千新星光谱的解译。
contribution: 本文利用Subaru/IRD设备获取了14颗覆盖不同有效温度、表面重力和丰度模式的化学奇特星的高分辨率近红外光谱，以扩展对重元素近红外强跃迁的认知。研究在大部分目标恒星中探测到了此前被认为是强跃迁的Sr II、Ce III和Gd III谱线，证实了它们的内禀重要性；同时在部分恒星中探测到了Eu II和Nd III谱线。通过比较等值宽度与丰度比，作者指出在重元素高度富集的环境下，Eu II和Nd III对千新星光谱特征的贡献可能与Sr II相当。此外，尽管观测样本扩大，本研究并未发现比上述跃迁更强的未知谱线。该结果进一步巩固了Sr II和Ce III谱线在千新星光谱中的主导地位，并为Eu II和Nd III的潜在贡献提供了新见解。
summary: Kilonova spectra provide information on rapid neutron-capture nucleosynthesis in neutron star mergers. However, it remains challenging to identify individual elements in kilonova spectra, primarily due to incomplete atomic data for heavy elements at near-infrared wavelengths. Recent work demonstrated that spectra of chemically peculiar stars offer excellent laboratory for studying kilonova spectra. In this paper, to expand our understanding of strong transitions of heavy elements at near-infrared wavelengths, we present high-resolution near-infrared spectra of 14 chemically peculiar stars covering a range of effective temperatures, surface gravities, and abundance patterns, obtained with Subaru/IRD. The Sr II, Ce III, and Gd III lines, previously suggested to be among the strongest transitions, are detected in the spectra of most of our targets, confirming their intrinsic importance. In addition, Eu II and Nd III lines are detected in several stars. By comparing observed equivalent widths and abundance ratios, we show that under a highly heavy-element-enriched abundance pattern, Eu II and Nd III lines may contribute to kilonova spectral features comparably to Sr II. Importantly, we find no unidentified lines systematically stronger than these transitions despite the larger stellar sample. These results further support the primary importance of the Sr II and Ce III transitions and provide new insights into the potential contribution of Eu II and Nd III.

title: A VLA Study of the Disturbed Massive Cluster PLCK G165.7 + 67.0 and Its Two Narrow Angle Tail Galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系团是宇宙中最大的引力束缚天体系统，其内部充满着高温、稀薄的星系团内介质（ICM）。当星系在星系团中高速穿行时，会受到ICM强大的冲压力（ram pressure）作用。如果该星系具有活跃的射电喷流，这种冲压力会将喷流向运动的相反方向吹弯，形成形态呈“U”型或“V”型的窄角尾（Narrow-Angle Tail, NAT）射电星系。在传统观测中，光谱测算通常只能提供天体的视向（径向）速度，横向速度极其难以限制，因此三维空间速度的测量往往局限于本地宇宙。而NAT射电星系喷流的弯曲形态和辐射老化特征，为天文学家提供了一种基于流体力学模型来估算较高红移星系团中星系横向及三维空间运动速度的独特探针。
contribution: 本研究利用甚大天线阵（VLA）15 GHz和6 GHz的连续谱数据，对大质量扰动星系团PLCK G165.7+67.0中的7个射电星系进行了高分辨率成像分析，成功分辨出两个背离星系团质心延伸的窄角尾（NAT）星系，并通过光谱指数图证实了沿着尾部符合辐射老化规律的梯度变化。作者结合马赫锥模型和基于欧拉方程的非相对论流体力学模型，推算出这两个NAT星系的三维空间速度均约为2000 km/s。研究还发现，其中一个NAT为该星系团的最亮星系（BCG），其具有高达-3300 km/s的径向速度，结合模型推断出极高的三维空间速度，表明该BCG可能正处于近距离穿越星系团核心（core passage）的剧烈动力学阶段。
summary: Since spectroscopic measurements provide only the line-of-sight velocity, transverse motions are difficult to constrain. As a result, transverse velocities have so far been measured only for local galaxies. Radio galaxies whose jets are bent back by ram pressure into nearly parallel Narrow-Angle Tails (NATs) offer a way to extend such measurements to higher redshifts. Here, we present proprietary 15 GHz (Ku-band) and archival 6 GHz (C-band) continuum observations from the Very Large Array (VLA) of seven radio galaxies in the galaxy cluster field PLCK G165.7+67.0 (G165). VLA imaging resolves two of the cluster galaxies into NATs whose tails both extend toward the Southwest, away from the cluster center of mass. Spectral index maps made at matched angular resolution resolve a steepening gradient consistent with radiative aging along the length of the tails. Physical properties of the NATs are measured and used to constrain two independent models: a Mach cone model and a nonrelativistic hydrodynamic flow model based on Euler's equation. The models returned space velocities of $\sim 2000 ~\rm km~ \rm s^{-1}$ for both galaxies. One NAT is the brightest cluster galaxy (BCG) and has a measured radial velocity of $-3300 ~\rm km ~\rm s^{-1}$, resulting in an even higher space velocity. The high inferred 3D velocity of the BCG may be explained if it is intercepted close to core passage.

title: ATLASGAL: The HCN-IR Star Formation Relation for the Milky Way
background_knowledge: 星际介质（ISM）中的致密分子云是恒星形成的温床。在天文学观测中，通常使用HCN（氰化氢）分子的辐射谱线来示踪高密度的分子气体，而红外（IR）光度则常被用作衡量恒星形成率（SFR）的指标，因为年轻恒星会加热周围的尘埃使其产生强烈的红外热辐射。在河外星系的宏观尺度观测中，人们通常发现HCN与红外光度之间存在明显的线性相关性，这被普遍解释为一种“普适的恒星形成定律”，即恒星形成率与致密气体质量直接成正比。然而，这种在星系平均尺度上观察到的线性关系，是否适用于银河系内部单个致密气体团块（微观尺度）以及处于不同演化阶段的恒星形成区，一直是星际介质与恒星形成领域需要验证的核心物理问题。
contribution: 本研究基于ATLASGAL巡天数据，分析了银河系中343个涵盖大质量恒星和星团形成完整演化阶段（宁静期、原恒星、年轻恒星体及HII区）的致密气体团块。研究发现，样本整体的HCN与红外光度关系斜率高达1.80±0.08，与河外星系的线性趋势显著不符；而在处于活跃恒星形成期的各个独立演化阶段中，斜率较缓（约1.2），宁静期团块则表现出无相关性。此外，估算表明致密团块仅贡献了银河系总HCN光度的5-25%（说明大量HCN并未示踪恒星形成气体）以及红外光度的2-3%（红外辐射主要由示踪更长时标的延展HII区和光致解离区主导）。因此，该论文提出，在近邻星系中观测到的HCN-IR线性关系，本质上是长时间、大空间尺度下恒星形成效率的平均结果，而非恒星形成率与致密气体质量之间的直接微观物理联系。
summary: We examine the relation between star formation and dense gas, traced by HCN(1-0), using a sample of 343 Galactic clumps spanning the full range of evolutionary stages representative of high-mass and cluster formation, including quiescent, protostellar, young stellar object (YSO), and HII regions. Earlier Galactic studies, based primarily on luminous HII regions, reported a linear correlation between infrared (IR) and HCN luminosities, consistent with extragalactic surveys, and interpreted it as a universal star formation law. Our larger evolutionary sample yields a significantly steeper slope of $1.80\pm0.08$, inconsistent with extragalactic trends. However, we find that each of the star-forming evolutionary stages individually has a shallower slope ($\sim$1.2) than that of the full sample, with quiescent clumps showing no correlation. We estimate the Milky Way's total IR and HCN luminosities from dense clumps by integrating the bolometric luminosities and clump masses of Hi-GAL sources. Both fall significantly below extragalactic values, demonstrating that clumps alone cannot account for the IR-HCN relation. Only $\sim$5-25 per cent of Galactic HCN luminosity arises from dense clumps, implying that most extragalactic HCN traces gas that is not involved in star formation. Additionally, dense clumps contribute only $\sim$2-3 per cent of the Milky Way's IR luminosity, which is dominated instead by extended HII regions and PDRs tracing longer star formation timescales. As a result, the observed linear relation in nearby galaxies reflects a nearly constant star formation efficiency averaged over large areas and long timescales, rather than a direct link between SFR and dense gas mass.

title: Metastable Neutron Stars as Transient-Rate Detectors of Heavy Dark Matter
background_knowledge: 暗物质占据了宇宙物质的绝大部分，但其微观本质仍是未解之谜。大质量暗物质（Heavy Dark Matter）或宏观暗物质是其中的重要理论模型。中子星是宇宙中密度极高的致密天体，其内部物质状态极端。理论预言，部分中子星可能处于“亚稳态”的强子物质阶段。如果暗物质粒子被中子星俘获并在其内部发生湮灭、衰变或散射，会产生局部的能量沉积。这种能量沉积能够成核并引发相变，使亚稳态中子星灾难性地转化为包含夸克物质的星体。这种剧烈转化会释放巨大能量，可能表现为短伽马射线暴（sGRB）等高能瞬变天文事件。以往的研究通常基于“某些古老中子星至今依然存活”这一事实，对暗物质的相互作用率施加单边限制。
contribution: 本文提出利用当前中子星群体的瞬变事件发生率（而非单个星体的存活率）来限制由暗物质诱发的中子星相变。研究表明，由于星族数量的消耗，当前的相变率呈现非单调特征：暗物质触发作用过弱会导致相变事件极少；而触发作用过强，则会使得过去形成的中子星早已转化完毕。因此，瞬变事件的观测能够排除一个有限的暗物质相互作用率区间，这与传统的单边存活限制存在定性上的区别。研究团队以经过聚束效应校正的短伽马射线暴发生率作为基准，推导了对暗物质湮灭、衰变、非弹性粒子散射以及宏观暗物质弹性散射的参数限制，覆盖了现有探测手段未曾触及的参数空间。该研究为探测暗区相互作用及超密物质相结构提供了一种全新的星族级别探针。
summary: Metastable neutron stars can undergo catastrophic conversion to quark-containing stars when a localized energy deposition nucleates a critical bubble. We show that dark-matter-induced conversions can be constrained by the present transient rate of the neutron star population, rather than by the survival of any individual hadronic star as often assumed in previous literature. Population depletion makes the present transition rate nonmonotonic: weak triggering produces few transitions, whereas sufficiently rapid triggering predominantly converts stars formed in the past. Consequently, transient observations can exclude a finite interval of interaction rates, qualitatively different from conventional one-sided survival bounds. Using the beaming-corrected short gamma ray burst rate as a benchmark, we derive constraints on dark matter annihilation, decay, inelastic particle scattering, and elastic scattering of macroscopic dark matter, including parameter space not covered by existing probes. Transient demographics thus provide a new population level probe of dark sector interactions and the phase structure of ultradense matter.

title: AKARI near-infrared spectroscopy of circumstellar hydrocarbon dust associated with young stellar objects
background_knowledge: 年轻星体（YSO）周围通常被富含气体与尘埃的星周盘或包层所环绕。多环芳烃（PAH）及脂肪烃是星际介质中普遍存在的碳基分子/尘埃成分，它们在近红外波段（如3.3微米的芳香族特征和3.4-3.6微米的脂肪族特征）具有特定的光谱印记。在恒星形成的早期，中心年轻星体的剧烈活动（如高能辐射、星风或高能粒子）会对星周物质进行强烈的物理和化学加工（processing）。通过红外光谱观测这些碳氢尘埃以及水冰、二氧化碳冰的光谱特征变化，能够有效追踪星周物质的演化历史，从而揭示恒星活动如何重塑并改变周围星际物质的物理化学组成。
contribution: 本研究利用AKARI卫星获取了10个年轻星体（YSOs）的2.6-4.4微米近红外长缝光谱，详细分析了星周多环芳烃（PAH）等碳氢尘埃在恒星活动下的加工过程。研究结果显示，不同目标在脂肪族与芳香族特征的通量比、特征轮廓形状及中心波长上存在显著差异；其中HD 97048和Elias 1展现出与氢化纳米钻石一致的长波长（>3.5微米）强脂肪族特征。研究指出，碳氢尘埃的加工程度可能与YSO的年龄及星周尘埃量有关；水冰和二氧化碳冰特征的变化与脂肪族特征轮廓之间存在相关性，暗示了CO2冰形成与脂肪烃加工的内在联系。基于这些发现，作者提出了一种暂定机制：在YSO活动产生的高能粒子的辐照下，星周多环芳烃可能被转化为了纳米钻石。
summary: We investigate the processing of the circumstellar polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) associated with young stellar objects (YSOs) through their stellar activities. We analyze the AKARI near-infrared (2.6$-$4.4 $μ$m) long-slit spectral data of 10 YSOs, focusing on the aromatic feature at a wavelength of 3.3 $μ$m and the aliphatic features at 3.4$-$3.6 $μ$m. The spectral fitting results show large variations from target to target in the flux ratio of the aliphatic to aromatic features, the shape of the aliphatic feature profile, and the central wavelength of the aromatic feature. In particular, HD 97048 and Elias 1 show strong aliphatic features at wavelengths longer than 3.5 $μ$m, which is consistent with the hydrogenated nanodiamond features reported in previous studies. We find that the properties of the hydrocarbon dust vary under the influence of the YSO activity, where the degree of dust processing is likely to be related to the age of the YSO and the amount of the circumstellar dust. In addition, correlation is observed between the variations of the H$_2$O and CO$_2$ ice features and the aliphatic feature profiles, suggesting connection between the formation of CO$_2$ ice and the processing of aliphatic hydrocarbons. Finally, we find a significant correlation between the variations in the central wavelength of the aromatic feature and the shape of the aliphatic feature profile. These findings may be consistent with a tentative scenario in which circumstellar PAHs are converted to nanodiamonds through irradiation by high-energy particles produced by YSO activity.

title: The JWST Proto-PAH project: Aromatic backbones with extensive aliphatic substitution account for both the aromatic and aliphatic emission
background_knowledge: 宇宙空间中存在大量的富碳分子和尘埃，其中多环芳烃（PAHs）被广泛认为是星际介质（ISM）中普遍存在的红外发射带的主要载体。渐近巨星分支后星（post-AGB stars）是中低质量恒星演化晚期的一个短暂过渡阶段，其富碳的星周包层是复杂有机分子和尘埃颗粒形成的重要场所。在红外光谱中，分子的特定振动模式会产生特征发射线，例如3.3微米通常对应芳香族（aromatic，即环状结构）的C-H键拉伸，而3.4微米对应脂肪族（aliphatic，即链状或非芳香族结构）的C-H键拉伸。研究这些富碳恒星包层中的红外特征，对于理解星际复杂有机物的化学起源及其向典型星际PAHs的演化过程（即“原PAHs”或Proto-PAHs模型）具有极其重要的意义。
contribution: 利用JWST的NIRSpec和MIRI/MRS高分辨率光谱（覆盖2.88至28.7微米），研究了四颗具有D类发射特征的富碳post-AGB星。观测发现其3.4微米脂肪族特征强于3.3微米芳香族特征，这与典型PAHs发射源的比例相反。结合光谱分析，若发射源为标准PAHs，理应存在强烈的8.6微米特征，但该特征在四个源中均微弱或缺失，从而排除了典型PAHs作为芳香族发射载体的可能性。研究得出核心结论：这四颗恒星中的芳香族和脂肪族发射带源自同一种载体群体，即拥有连续芳香骨架但带有异常丰富脂肪族修饰基团的分子。这些载体比行星状星云和星际介质中的PAHs具有显著更高的脂肪族含量。
summary: We find that the aromatic and aliphatic emission bands in four carbon-rich post-asymptotic giant branch stars with class D emission arise from a single carrier population: extensive aliphatic decoration of an aromatic skeleton, i.e. molecules with a coherent aromatic backbone and an unusually high aliphatic content. This conclusion is based on JWST NIRSpec and MIRI/MRS spectroscopy, covering 2.88-28.7um. The aliphatic 3.4um feature is stronger than the aromatic 3.3um feature, reversing the ratio seen in sources with typical polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) emission. If the aromatic emission arose from nominal PAHs, the 3.3um feature - unavailable in previous observations - together with the mid-infrared aromatic features, would constrain them to be large (greater than about carbon atoms), compact, and at least partially ionized. These properties predict a strong 8.6um feature. However, the 8.6um feature is weak or absent in all four sources, ruling out PAHs as the source of the aromatic emission. Instead, the emission must arise from the same carriers as the aliphatic emission. The position of the 6.9um feature and the broadened 11-14um out-of-plane emission independently support this. The CH2 and CH3 feature strengths vary across the sample, with the class D2 sources showing higher CH3 content. These carriers are far more aliphatic than the PAHs of planetary nebulae and the interstellar medium. However, they retain the aromatic skeleton that produces their aromatic features.

title: MATISSE-py: a high-level Python interface for efficient, automated VLTI/MATISSE data reduction
background_knowledge: 甚大望远镜干涉仪（VLTI）通过组合多个望远镜的光束，能够实现极高空间分辨率的天文观测。MATISSE（多孔径中红外光谱实验）是VLTI上的中红外干涉仪器，能够提供丰富的空间干涉数据集（如可见度、闭合相位等），广泛应用于恒星形成、活动星系核和原行星盘等领域的研究。然而，干涉数据的处理极为复杂，传统的官方数据归算流水线通常依赖繁琐的命令行调用、手动编辑配置文件及人工迭代，这不仅难以自动化和复现，也不易与现代Python科学计算生态系统无缝集成。因此，开发自动化、用户友好且集成高级校正算法的高阶数据处理接口，对于提升干涉观测数据的科学转化率至关重要。
contribution: 本文开发并发布了MATISSE-py，这是一个模块化且开源的Python工具包，为VLTI/MATISSE的数据归算提供高效的高层接口。该工具将官方ESO流水线封装为单一的集成命令，实现了数据的自动发现、归算、校准与检验。除了自动化，它还引入了团队积累7年的科学级改进方案，包括：利用GRAVITY条纹追踪器推导可见度和测光因子（V-factor和P-factor）以校正残余可见度损失、单基线数据过滤、光束切换设备（BCD）校正，以及使用最新参考光谱进行的绝对分光光度通量校准。在观测条件不佳且目标暗弱的情况下，该工具的校正算法能恢复部分可见度损失，将统计不确定性降低近20%，并确保不同设备模式下的校准结果一致，从而显著缩短了天文界从数据处理到科学分析的周期。
summary: The Multi AperTure mid-Infrared SpectroScopic Experiment (MATISSE) at the Very Large Telescope Interferometer (VLTI) delivers rich mid-infrared interferometric datasets that are reduced through a robust, multi-stage ESO pipeline. In its native form, however, the reduction relies on command-line calls to esorex, hand-edited set-of-files (SOF) and configuration files, and manual iterations that are difficult to automate, reproduce, or integrate into modern Python workflows. We present MATISSE-py, a modular Python interface that wraps the official ESO esorex recipes behind a single, user-friendly matisse command. It automates discovery, reduction, calibration, and inspection of the data, and ships as a tested, open-source package built on industry-standard practices. Beyond convenience, MATISSE-py introduces science-grade improvements developed over seven years of MATISSE operations: visibility- and photometry-factor (V-factor and P-factor) corrections derived from the GRAVITY fringe tracker to mitigate residual visibility losses, per-baseline data filtering, beam-commuting-device (BCD) "magic-number" corrections, and an absolute spectrophotometric flux calibration using state-of-the-art reference spectra. On faint targets observed under degraded conditions, the V-factor correction recovers up to a few percent of lost visibility and reduces the statistical uncertainties by nearly 20%, while yielding calibrator diameters that are consistent across BCD modes. MATISSE-py thus consolidates the consortium's expertise into a maintainable package and shortens the reduction-to-science loop for the community.

title: Kruglov-entropy cosmology from apparent-horizon thermodynamics: background dynamics and observational constraints
background_knowledge: 在现代宇宙学与引力理论中，引力与热力学之间存在深刻的内在联系。自二十世纪七十年代黑洞热力学建立以来，物理学家发现可以将热力学第一定律推广到宇宙的表观视界（Apparent Horizon）上，从而推导出描述宇宙膨胀的弗里德曼（Friedmann）方程。近年来，为了解释宇宙晚期的加速膨胀（即暗能量问题），研究人员提出使用各种广义的、非可加性熵（如Tsallis熵、Barrow熵以及Kruglov熵）来替代标准的Bekenstein-Hawking面积熵。对视界熵的修正会改变背景演化动力学方程，从而在宏观上产生类似暗能量的效应。这类基于修正熵的宇宙学模型（熵宇宙学）需要利用诸如重子声学振荡（BAO）、宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）以及Ia型超新星等现代宇宙学观测数据进行严格的唯象检验与参数限制。
contribution: 本文深入研究了基于表观视界Kruglov非可加性熵的两种晚期宇宙学模型：模型I（遵循Cai-Kim热力学构造，推导出隐式修正的弗里德曼方程）和模型II（本文提出的基于熵积分处方的模型，包含有效真空贡献）。作者结合DESI DR2的BAO数据、压缩的CMB似然以及DES-Y5的超新星数据对两者进行了观测限制。结果表明，模型I预测了极低的哈勃常数（$H_0 \simeq 62.4$）且显著劣于平坦$\Lambda$CDM模型；模型II在标准宇宙学参数上与$\Lambda$CDM高度一致，但其额外引入的参数未能通过信息准则的支持。该研究核心发现是：同一种非可加性熵的不同热力学实现方式会在宏观背景动力学上产生截然不同的唯象结果，表明广义视界熵引入弗里德曼动力学的具体方式决定了该类熵宇宙学模型在观测上的合理性。
summary: We investigate two late-time cosmological models generated by Kruglov's nonadditive entropy at the apparent horizon. Model I, originally derived by Kruglov, follows the Cai--Kim thermodynamic construction and leads to an implicit modified Friedmann equation, whereas Model II, proposed and derived in this work, is obtained from an entropy-integral prescription and contains an effective vacuum contribution. We formulate both models in terms of the dimensionless Hubble parameter, include radiation, impose exact present-day closure, and evolve the physical branch using analytic derivatives of the implicit Friedmann equations. We constrain the models with DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations and a compressed CMB likelihood, with and without DES-Y5 Type-Ia supernovae. Model I is driven to a markedly lower Hubble constant, $H_0\simeq62.4,\mathrm{km,s^{-1},Mpc^{-1}}$ for the combined data, and remains non-phantom with $w_{\rm DE,0}\simeq-0.814$; it is strongly disfavoured relative to flat $Λ$CDM. Model II stays close to $Λ$CDM in the standard cosmological parameters and gives $w_{\rm DE,0}\simeq-1.003$, while its two entropy-sector parameters remain strongly degenerate. Its best-fit likelihood is comparable to $Λ$CDM, but the additional parameters are not supported by information criteria. These results show that the two thermodynamic realizations of the same nonadditive entropy have sharply different phenomenological consequences at the homogeneous-background level. In summary, the observational plausibility of entropy-based cosmology hinges critically on how the generalized horizon entropy is incorporated into the Friedmann dynamics.

title: Tracing out massive fields in cosmology
background_knowledge: 在早期宇宙（如暴胀时期）的研究中，宇宙近似处于德西特（de Sitter）或准德西特时空背景。为了计算宇宙学关联函数（这些关联函数与微波背景辐射和宇宙大尺度结构的初始涨落直接相关），物理学家通常采用“in-in”形式化方法（即Schwinger-Keldysh路径积分）。在复杂的暴胀模型（如准单场模型）中，除了驱动暴胀的轻场，往往还存在质量较大的重场。由于近代的宇宙学观测通常只涉及轻场产生的涨落，理论上可以通过有效场论（EFT）的方法将重场的自由度“积掉”（integrate out），从而得到仅包含轻场的有效描述。这种有效描述最严谨的数学表达方式是约化密度矩阵，它不仅能捕捉多场相互作用引发的非高斯性（如双谱），还能处理开放量子系统中的退相干与分支混合效应。
contribution: 本文研究了在德西特时空中，如何通过积掉大质量重场来推导有限观测时间下轻场的约化密度矩阵。研究从具有非线性耦合的准单场模型出发，计算了固定终态值下的重场波泛函并对其求迹，发现该过程会产生Schwinger-Keldysh描述中普遍存在的分支混合项。对于共形耦合的重场，作者明确证明了由有效描述算出的轻场双谱与全理论计算结果完全一致，并指出重场在未来边界的衰减不能作为在求迹时直接忽略其贡献的理由。此外，论文详细探讨了精确的非局域有效描述与基于大质量展开的局域有效场论之间的差异，甄别了哪些局域三次项会影响晚期概率、哪些仅贡献波泛函相位。最后，作者根据响应、噪声和Schwinger-Keldysh一致性条件对推导出的核（kernels）进行了系统分类，并讨论了约化密度矩阵所受的对称性约束。
summary: Cosmological correlators are calculated through the in-in formalism in (quasi-)de Sitter background. Its effective description is best represented by a reduced density matrix. In this work, we study how integrating out a massive field in de Sitter space determines the reduced density matrix of a light field at a finite observation time. Starting from a quasi-single-field model with non-linear couplings, we first evaluate the massive field wavefunctional at fixed final value and then trace over this value. The trace generates branch-mixing terms which are generally present in the Schwinger--Keldysh description. For a conformally coupled massive field, we show explicitly that the light field bispectrum from the effective description agrees with a full theory calculation. This example also shows that decay of a field at the future boundary does not by itself justify discarding its contribution to the trace. We discuss the differences between an exact nonlocal effective description and the local effective field theory obtained through a large mass expansion. We then identify which local cubic terms affect the late-time probability and which contribute only a wavefunctional phase. Finally, we organize the resulting kernels by response, noise, and Schwinger--Keldysh consistency conditions, and discuss the symmetry constraints on the reduced density matrix.

title: Hybrid Partial Dressing: Correct Effective Potentials at All Temperatures
background_knowledge: 在早期宇宙和基础物理学中，有限温度量子场论是研究宇宙早期相变（如电弱相变）的核心工具。当宇宙膨胀冷却时，标量场（例如希格斯场或超出标准模型的新粒子场）可能经历自发对称性破缺，引发强一阶相变。这种相变不仅是解释宇宙重子不对称性的关键，还会产生极具探测价值的随机引力波背景。为了准确描述相变动力学，物理学家需要计算标量场的有限温度有效势。然而，由于高温下的红外发散，传统的微扰展开会失效，必须采用‘图重和’（resummation，如菊花图重和）或‘降维’（Dimensional Reduction）等有效场论技术来修正红外行为，从而获得在不同温度区间内物理上可靠的有效势模型。
contribution: 本文提出了一种名为‘混合部分修饰（Hybrid Partial Dressing, HPD）’的简单图重和方案，用于计算标量场论中在所有温度下均有效的有限温度有效势。该方案改进了以往的菊花图重和与部分修饰方法，在全温度范围内精确到两圈图（two-loop exact），消除了重叠动量问题，并且易于实施重整化群（RG）改进。作者在具有自发破缺Z_2对称性的多标量场理论中验证了该方案，证明其在高温极限下能够完美再现两圈降维（DR）有效势，同时在全温区保持有效。通过对引力波信号的预测，本文展示了HPD及其重整化群改进版本（RGHPD）在研究超出标准模型的强一阶相变中的重要应用价值。
summary: We develop Hybrid Partial Dressing (HPD), a simple diagrammatic resummation scheme for finite-temperature effective potentials in scalar field theory which is valid at all temperatures. HPD improves on earlier resummation schemes such as Daisy Resummation and Partial Dressing by being two-loop exact at all temperatures and free of the overlapping momentum problem. Renormalization group improvement is straightforward to implement. We illustrate the scheme in multi-scalar theories with a spontaneously broken $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry, and compare it against existing approaches, showing in particular that it reproduces the two-loop Dimensional Reduction (DR) potential exactly in the high-temperature regime where DR applies, while remaining valid at all temperatures. This makes HPD suitable for the general study of strong first order phase transitions beyond the Standard Model, as we demonstrate through gravitational wave predictions from HPD and its RG-improved version, RGHPD.

title: MAGGIE: A Magnetic Gravitational Wave Induction Experiment
background_knowledge: 引力波是时空曲率的涟漪，传统的引力波探测器（如LIGO和Virgo）主要针对频率在赫兹（Hz）到千赫兹（kHz）区间的信号。然而，千赫兹至兆赫兹（kHz-MHz）甚至更高频段的高频引力波（HFGWs），其潜在波源通常涉及原初黑洞（PBH）的合并、宇宙弦等早期宇宙的极端物理过程。在物理机制上，根据线性化引力理论对麦克斯韦方程组的修正，引力波在传播穿过外部强电磁场时，能够通过相互作用诱导出有效的电磁电流。这一理论图像促使了探测范式的创新：科学家们开始利用原本用于搜寻轴子暗物质的强磁场共振设备（即轴子晕镜实验，Axion Haloscopes）来跨界探测高频引力波，为探索超出标准模型的新物理和早期宇宙演化提供了全新的实验途径。
contribution: 本文提出了欧洲首个集总参数高频引力波探测器——MAGGIE（磁感应引力波实验）。该实验依托汉堡大学的14特斯拉（T）超导螺线管磁体，旨在探测kHz至MHz频段的高频引力波。研究团队专门设计了定制的拾取线圈以捕获引力波诱导的磁通量，采用“8字形”几何结构来打破方位角对称性，并结合盲环（blind-loop）配置实现实时的噪声抑制与校准。读取方案专为连续信号和基于原初黑洞（PBH）合并波形模板的瞬态时域搜索而量身定制。性能预测表明，在40 MHz高频端，瞬态搜索的应变谱噪声密度预计可达约 4 \times 10^{-16}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}；对于为期1年的连续搜索，应变极限预计可达到 10^{-19}。MAGGIE实验将有能力对目前尚未探索的高频引力波参数空间施加重要限制。
summary: Gravitational waves (GWs) can induce effective electromagnetic currents when interacting with external electric and magnetic fields, as described by linearized gravity modifications to Maxwell's equations. This coupling enables a novel detection approach for high-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs) using axion haloscope experiments. Here we present the MAGnetic Gravitational wave Induction Experiment (MAGGIE), the first lumped-element HFGW detector proposed in Europe, designed to probe HFGWs in the kHz-MHz regime by leveraging a 14 T solenoidal magnet at the University of Hamburg. The GW-induced magnetic flux is captured by a custom-designed pickup loop optimized for the expected symmetry of the effective current. A figure-8-shaped geometry, oriented to break the azimuthal symmetry, is implemented, together with a blind-loop configuration, for real-time noise rejection and calibration. The readout scheme is tailored for continuous signals and time-domain transient searches, using waveform templates for primordial black hole (PBH) mergers. The expected experimental reach in terms of strain spectral noise density at the 40 MHz high-frequency end is projected to reach $\sim 4 \times 10^{-16}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ for transient searches, and in terms of strain, projected to reach $\sim 10^{-19}$ for 1 year of continuous search. This allows MAGGIE to constrain currently unexplored regions of the HFGW parameter space.

title: FPCA-Enhanced Simulation-Based Inference for Robust Type Ia Supernova Cosmology
background_knowledge: Ia型超新星（Type Ia Supernova）因其具有高度一致的峰值光度，被天文学家广泛作为‘标准烛光’来测量宇宙学距离，是揭示宇宙加速膨胀及研究暗能量状态方程的核心探针。在现代时域宽视场测光巡天（如暗能量巡天DES、薇拉·鲁宾天文台LSST）中，海量数据极大地压低了统计误差，使得系统误差（如仪器效应、观测选择效应、尘埃消光及宿主星系依赖性等）成为限制精确宇宙学的主要瓶颈。传统的宇宙学推断通常依赖于标准的光变曲线拟合模型（如SALT2）和封闭形式的解析似然函数。然而，由于巡天系统特征日趋复杂，基于模拟的推断（Simulation-Based Inference, SBI）逐渐兴起。SBI通过正向模拟囊括各种复杂的巡天特征与系统误差，绕过了计算显式似然函数的困难。此外，为了克服传统SALT2模板过于刚性的建模假设，利用更加灵活的数据驱动方法（如主成分分析）来提取光变曲线特征成为该领域的重要研究方向。
contribution: 本文首次将函数主成分分析（FPCA）提取的光变曲线参数作为基于模拟推断（SBI）的汇总统计量，用于非平坦ΛCDM模型下的宇宙学参数约束。研究表明，在同源模拟数据上，FPCA+SBI的方法能产生与传统SALT2+SBI及显式似然分析相当的约束精度，并在域外模拟数据上展现出优于SALT2的鲁棒性。将基于类LSST光变曲线训练的模型应用于DES第五年（Y5）光谱确认超新星样本时，获得的Ωm和ΩΛ参数约束与DES合作组官方结果的一致性分别达到0.12σ和0.23σ内，证实了该方法对真实数据的泛化能力。此外，研究揭示FPCA能够隐式地编码宿主星系相关的系统误差（例如依赖于质量的尘埃消光规律），从而可能免除了显式宿主建模的需求。FPCA凭借其兼顾测光分类和宇宙学参数推断的能力，为未来宽视场测光巡天建立统一的数据驱动分析管道提供了坚实基础。
summary: Precision cosmology is a cornerstone of modern astronomy, and upcoming wide-field photometric surveys make it crucial to develop robust, data-driven inference methods that can handle complex survey systematics without relying on closed-form likelihoods. Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) meets this need by enabling forward simulations that encode complex survey characteristics. Previous SBI analyses in supernova cosmology have used SALT2 light-curve parameters as summary statistics; however, SALT2's two-basis spectral template imposes rigid modeling assumptions, motivating a more flexible representation. In this work, we present the first application of Functional Principal Component Analysis (FPCA) light-curve parameters as summary statistics for SBI-based cosmological inference under a non-flat ΛCDM model. On identically generated simulations, FPCA+SBI yields constraints comparable to both SALT2-based SBI and explicit-likelihood analyses, while providing more robust constraints on out-of-domain simulations than SALT2. Applying the model trained on LSST-like light curves to a spectroscopically confirmed DES Year 5 supernova sample, we recover constraints consistent with those of the DES collaboration to within 0.12 σ and 0.23 σ in Ωm and ΩΛ respectively, establishing the method's generalizability to real survey data. By introducing host-dependent systematics through a mass-dependent dust extinction law, we find FPCA-based summary statistics implicitly encode host-dependent systematics, suggesting dedicated host modeling may be unnecessary within this framework. Combined with its previously demonstrated effectiveness for photometric classification, FPCA offers a compelling foundation for unified, data-driven pipelines capable of jointly performing supernova classification and cosmological inference for upcoming wide-field photometric surveys.

title: KBSS-InCLOSE II: First Detailed Insights on the Inner CGM of Low-Mass $z\sim2.3$ Galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系周围介质（Circumgalactic Medium, CGM）是环绕星系并延伸至星系维里半径的广阔气体晕。它扮演着星系演化中的“呼吸系统”——既是星系吸积冷却气体以提供恒星形成原料的物质来源，也是星系反馈过程（如超新星爆发或星风）喷出物质和重元素的储存库。由于CGM自身辐射非常微弱，天文学家通常利用背景亮源（如类星体 QSO）的光谱，通过分析视线方向上气体产生的特征吸收线（如不同电离态的金属离子）来探测其物理、化学和运动学性质。在宇宙恒星形成高峰期（红移 z~2-3），低质量星系的CGM物理图像对于完善星系演化与气体循环模型至关重要，但以往受限于观测极限，对其内部核心区域的精细刻画极为匮乏。
contribution: 本研究通过KBSS-InCLOSE巡天项目，首次对红移 z~2.3 的两个低质量星系（恒星质量 <= 10^9 太阳质量）的内部星系周围介质（距星系中心 < 50 kpc）进行了详细观测分析。研究发现：其CGM中缺乏低电离态金属吸收，但普遍存在中等及高电离态（如C IV, O VI）吸收；气体运动学结构复杂（包含至少7个吸收组分），且未发现明确的非束缚（逃逸）气体。此外，多数气体组分的温度与宇宙极紫外背景辐射加热相符，气体内部湍流呈现亚音速，而在晕内的整体运动多为超音速。该成果揭示了在 z~2.3 时期，CGM的运动学复杂度和非束缚气体比例会随星系的恒星质量发生变化，但热力学性质却保持相似。
summary: We present results from an extension to the Keck Baryonic Structure Survey (KBSS) that focuses on the Inner Circumgalactic Medium (CGM) of QSO Line Of Sight Emitting galaxies at z$\sim$2.3 (InCLOSE). We analyze two low-mass galaxies $\log{(\rm{M_*} / \rm{M_\odot})} \leq 9$ that are within small a projected distance of a QSO $D_{\rm tran} \leq 50~{\rm kpc}$ ($D_{\rm tran} /R_{\rm vir} \leq 0.75$). One galaxy is detected as a bright Lyman- Emitter with Keck/KCWI (confirmed with follow-up Keck/MOSFIRE spectra), and the other as a serendipitous line emitter with Keck/MOSFIRE. Both galaxies have nebular and morphological properties consistent with those of typical low-mass z$\sim$2.3 star-forming galaxies. Analysis of their CGM absorption as seen with Keck/HIRES spectra of the background QSOs shows no detections of low-ionization metal absorption (low-ions; e.g., Si II), ubiquitous detections of intermediate- (e.g., C IV) and high-ions (O VI), kinematically complex absorption ($\geq$7 components per galaxy halo) spread over $|Δv|\pm 150~{\rm km~s^{-1}}$, and no unambiguously unbound gas is detected in either galaxy halo. We analyze the thermal properties of a subset of CGM components, finding that the majority (6/10) have temperatures consistent with heating from the metagalactic UV background ($\log{(T/\rm{K})_{\mathrm{med}}}=4.0$) while the remainder possess short-lived, intermediate temperature gas that would require additional heating or rapid replenishment ($4.6 \leq \log{(T/\rm{K})} \leq 5.1$), the internal energy of these absorbers are dominated by thermal broadening, their internal (turbulent) velocities are all subsonic, while their motions through the halo are likely supersonic. These results hint that the z2.3 CGM changes with stellar mass in terms of kinematic complexity and unbound gas fraction, while thermal properties remain similar.

title: On the Compositions of Interstellar Objects
background_knowledge: 星际天体（Interstellar Objects, ISOs）是指那些起源于其他恒星系统、在引力弹射等作用下脱离母星并穿梭于星际空间，最终偶然造访我们太阳系的小天体（如1I/'Oumuamua和2I/Borisov）。它们相当于系外行星系统投递到太阳系的‘实体样本’，为人类提供了直接探究太阳系外行星形成环境的独特窗口。在恒星与行星系统的形成过程中，原行星盘的化学成分与母恒星的元素丰度（特别是金属丰度）息息相关，这些化学条件决定了盘中凝聚出的微行星（包括彗星）的挥发性物质（如水、氨、一氧化碳、氮气等）的比例。因此，通过观测星际天体在靠近太阳时受热释放的气体成分（特别是挥发分在阳光下光解产生的子产物），天文学家可以反推其母恒星的化学特征及该天体的形成机制。APOGEE等大规模银河系恒星光谱巡天项目提供了海量的恒星元素丰度数据，为建立恒星化学性质与星际天体成分之间的宏观联系提供了数据基础。
contribution: 本论文将化学分配模型与APOGEE DR17巡天项目中的恒星元素丰度样本相结合，预测了星际天体中常见彗星挥发分的丰度。研究发现，星际天体的化学成分随母恒星的不同而存在显著差异。核心发现是：星际天体的氨（NH3）丰度与其母恒星的金属丰度呈强正相关（高金属丰度恒星将产生富氨的星际天体），表明NH3的光解子产物生成率是追踪星际天体起源的理想观测指标。基于此模型，研究推断2I/Borisov形成于接近太阳金属丰度（-0.4 ≲ [Fe/H] ≲ 0.3）的恒星周围，并印证了3I/ATLAS形成于较低金属丰度（-0.8 ≲ [Fe/H] ≲ 0.0）恒星周围的推论。此外，研究指出2I和3I的气体生成率表明它们仅含有被包裹在低挥发性冰层中的超挥发分（如CO和N2），这与典型的太阳系彗星相似；但作者同时论证了真正富含超挥发分冰的星际天体存在的可能性（它们会表现出极高的CO和N2生成率比例）。该研究为未来星际天体的观测发现及其起源系统的物理反演提供了重要的理论框架。
summary: As physical samples of distant planetary systems, the compositions of interstellar objects (ISOs) should correlate with the properties of their diverse parent stars. We combine a chemical partition model with a sample of stellar elemental abundances from APOGEE DR17 to predict the abundances of commonly-observed cometary volatiles in ISOs. We find that the compositions of ISOs vary significantly between different stars. In particular, we predict a strong correlation between an ISO's ammonia abundance and its parent star's metallicity: high-metallicity stars will create ISOs rich in ammonia. This suggests the production rates of NH$_3$'s photolytic daughter products are an ideal observational tracer for the origins of ISOs. We infer that 2I/Borisov formed around a star of near-solar metallicity ($-0.4\lesssim[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]\lesssim0.3$), and corroborate the velocity- and isotope-based inferences that 3I/ATLAS formed around a lower-metallicity star ($-0.8\lesssim[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]\lesssim0.0$). The production rates of 2I and 3I imply both only contain hypervolatiles such as CO and N$_2$ that are trapped in other less-volatile ices, similar to typical Solar System comets. Despite this, we argue that true hypervolatile-ice-rich ISOs may exist; they would exhibit high CO and N$_2$ production rate ratios, possibly similar to those of C/2016 R2 (PanSTARRS). Our predictions provide context for future ISO discoveries, opening a path to link the properties of their origin systems to observable production rates.

title: A Cyanopolyyne-rich but COM-poor Massive Protostar: The First Hot Carbon Chain Chemistry Source G28.28-0.36
background_knowledge: 在恒星形成的早期阶段，分子云核发生引力坍缩形成原恒星。随着原恒星的演化，其辐射会加热周围的致密气体和尘埃包层，使得原本冻结在尘埃颗粒表面的分子（或其前体）升华到气相中，从而引发丰富的气相化学反应。传统上，大质量年轻恒星体（MYSO）周围的高温致密区域常被称为‘热核（Hot Core）’，其典型化学特征是极度富含复杂的有机分子（COMs，如甲醇等）。然而，星际化学中还存在另一种以碳链分子（如氰基多炔烃）为主的化学演化路径（如小质量恒星中的温碳链化学 WCCC）。这类碳链化学的出现通常与分子云早期的物理条件（如气体的碳氧比、坍缩时标以及尘埃表面冰幔的形成过程）密切相关。探索大质量恒星形成区中是否也存在类似的碳链化学主导阶段（即热碳链化学 HCCC），对于完善我们对恒星形成过程中物质化学演化多样性的理解至关重要。
contribution: 利用阿塔卡马大型毫米波/亚毫米波阵列（ALMA）Band 3的数据，对大质量年轻恒星体（MYSO）G28.28-0.36进行了分子发射线观测。研究探测到了氰基多炔烃（HC3N和HC5N）及三种复杂有机分子（COMs）。观测发现，HC5N的发射峰与尘埃连续谱峰值重合，且根据CH3CN推导出的局部激发温度高达100 K，这表明G28.28周围的高温区域通过热碳链化学（HCCC）机制生成了大量的氰基多炔烃。与以往研究的MYSO不同，G28.28展现出‘富含氰基多炔烃但缺乏COMs’的独特化学特征，证实其为小质量温碳链化学（WCCC）源L1527的大质量对应体。这是天文学界迄今为止确认的首个热碳链化学（HCCC）源。
summary: We present molecular emission line data from the massive young stellar object (MYSO) G28.28-0.36 (G28.28) obtained with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array Band 3. Cyanopolyynes (HC$_3$N and HC$_5$N) and three complex organic molecules (COMs; CH$_3$OH, CH$_3$CN, and CH$_3$CHO) are detected from the MYSO G28.28. In addition, strong emission regions of cyanopolyynes are identified between G28.28 and a nearby ultracompact H II region. The HC$_5$N emission is coincident with the dust continuum peak, where an excitation temperature of 100 K is derived from CH$_3$CN. These results suggest that the Hot Carbon Chain Chemistry (HCCC) mechanism produces cyanopolyynes in the hot region around G28.28. We find that G28.28 exhibits a unique chemical feature: cyanopolyynes are abundant, but COMs are deficient, unlike the other MYSOs studied previously. These results imply that G28.28 is a counterpart of the Warm Carbon Chain Chemistry (WCCC) low-mass source L1527. G28.28 is the first HCCC source identified so far.

title: Tails and Trails: Comets and NEOs Survive Co-addition in Rubin Early Data Preview 2
background_knowledge: 在现代大规模时域天文巡天（如Vera C. Rubin天文台的LSST项目）中，数据处理管线通常会将同一天区的多次曝光图像进行叠加（co-addition），以大幅提高信噪比并探测极其暗弱的静态天体（如遥远星系）。然而，太阳系内的小天体（如彗星和近地天体 NEO）由于具有相对背景恒星的显著自行运动，在多次曝光叠加时其信号往往会被平均化或作为伪影被剔除。但在叠加深度较浅的区域（即仅包含一两次单次曝光，称为 shallow coadds），这些移动天体由于其特殊的扩展形态特征——例如彗星因冰物质升华而产生的彗发与彗尾（tails），以及近地天体在曝光期间因快速移动而在图像上拉出的长条轨迹（trails）——依然能够被有效识别。对这些小天体的搜寻与监测，对于理解太阳系的起源与演化、物质组成以及行星防御（监测潜在威胁小行星）具有不可替代的基础性作用。
contribution: 研究团队开发了一套专用的数据处理工作流，在Rubin天文台早期数据预览2（EDP2）的深场叠加图像中成功识别出“浅叠加”（仅包含一两次曝光）区域，并借此搜寻已知的太阳系小天体。研究证实，彗星活动和近地天体轨迹由于具有扩展形态，能够在这些浅叠加图像中幸存并被识别。作者从约700个切片中识别出32个天体的59次活动，其中包括首次发现小行星2025 NC6的活跃现象、首次确认2008 QZ44在过近日点前的活动，并找回了多颗已知彗星。此外，研究还恢复了336个近地天体（其中29个具有长尾迹），提供了可供立即跟进观测的候选目标，证明了巡天数据中被忽视的浅叠加区域在移动天体科学研究中具有巨大的应用价值。
summary: We identify effectively single-visit imaging hidden within the deep co-added images of the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory Early Data Preview 2 (EDP2). These shallow regions contain only one or two contributing visits, providing access to single-visit-depth imaging ahead of the full Data Preview 2 (DP2) release in late 2026. We develop a workflow to locate known small Solar System bodies in these data, using our Ponder orchestrator with the Sorcha survey simulator to predict their positions and the Rubin Science Platform (RSP) to identify shallow coadds and extract image cutouts. Because cometary activity and near-Earth-object (NEO) trails produce extended morphologies, both remain identifiable in these shallow coadds. From approximately 700 comet and active-object cutouts, we identify 59 activity detections spanning 32 objects. We discover activity in 2025 NC6, previously unknown to be active; identify the first reported pre-perihelion activity of 2008 QZ44; and independently rediscover known comets 243P/NEAT and 510P/Boattini through their activity. We also recover 336 NEO cutouts, including 29 with predicted trails longer than 25 pixels. We provide accompanying galleries and tabular data, and highlight 99P/Kowal 1, 510P, and 303P/NEAT as targets for immediate follow-up. Shallow coadds are a relatively unexplored facet of Rubin data with applications beyond the Solar System examples presented here: regions with varying numbers of contributing visits will persist throughout the Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST).

title: SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E: Ubiquitous Cool Gas Outflows with Large Mass-Loading Factors in $z\sim0.7$ Post-starburst Galaxies
background_knowledge: 星系演化领域的一个核心谜题是“星系猝灭”（Quenching），即星系如何快速耗尽或失去冷气体从而停止恒星形成。后星暴星系（Post-starburst Galaxies, PSBs）正处于经历了剧烈恒星形成后迅速“熄火”的演化过渡期，是研究猝灭机制的理想实验室。为了解释这种快速熄火，理论模型通常引入反馈机制（如强烈的星暴驱动或活动星系核AGN驱动），产生大尺度的气体外流，将作为恒星形成原料的冷气吹离星系甚至吹出星系晕。观测上，天文学家常利用光谱中特定金属离子的吸收线（如Mg II和Fe II）的蓝移特征来追踪这些冷气体外流，并通过测算其速度和质量负载因子（外流质量消耗率与恒星形成率的比值）来评估反馈作用对星系演化的实际影响。
contribution: 本文利用SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E巡天项目中超过1300个中等红移（$0.5<z<0.9$）后星暴星系样本，通过叠加Fe II和Mg II吸收线光谱，系统表征了冷气体外流特征。研究发现，除猝灭时间已超过2.6亿年的星系外，冷气体外流在这些过渡期星系中普遍存在，且外流速度随猝灭时间的增加而衰减。这些外流具有极高的质量负载因子（1-120），最大速度超越了宿主星系的逃逸速度，且其能量与动量远超当前恒星形成活动所能提供的上限。这表明它们很可能是由过往星暴或AGN活动遗留的产物，证明了冷气体外流能够将气体大规模排入星系晕，在驱动星系快速猝灭的过程中发挥着关键作用。
summary: While recent James Webb Space Telescope studies have highlighted cool gas outflows as an important mechanism for rapid quenching at $z\gtrsim2$, such space-based spectroscopic samples remain limited in size. In this work, we search for and characterize cool gas outflows traced by Fe II $λλ$2586,2600 and Mg II $λλ$2796,2803 absorption in post-starburst galaxies (PSBs) at $0.5<z<0.9$, which are accessible to ground-based spectroscopy. Utilizing the SQuIGG$\vec{L}$E survey containing over 1300 PSBs, we stack spectra in bins of stellar mass, (specific) star formation rate, burst mass, burst mass fraction, and time since quenching. We observe blueshifted line centroids indicative of outflows in all stacks except the one containing galaxies that quenched more than 260 Myr ago. Outflow velocities decline with increasing time since quenching, while showing little correlation with other galaxy properties. The inferred outflows have large mass loading factors of 1 -- 120, maximum velocities above the interstellar medium escape velocities of their host galaxies, and energy and momentum fluxes exceeding those expected from the current star formation. Our results suggest that cool gas outflows are ubiquitous in intermediate-redshift PSBs and are likely relic outflows launched by previous starburst or AGN activity. These outflows have the potential to quench star formation by transporting gas into the galactic halos, consistent with outflows playing an important role in rapid quenching from intermediate to high redshift.

title: H2 emission in the Orion Bar, NGC7023 and the Horsehead Nebula observed with the James Webb Space Telescope
background_knowledge: 星际介质（ISM）充满了星系内恒星之间的空间，其中光致解离区（Photodissociation Regions, PDRs）是ISM物理与化学演化的核心实验室。PDRs通常位于年轻大质量恒星附近，恒星发出的远紫外（FUV）光子在此区域内主导了气体的加热、化学反应以及分子的激发与解离过程。作为宇宙中最丰富的分子，分子氢（H2）的转动和振转跃迁线是探测PDRs物理属性（如温度、密度分布以及辐射场特征）的重要工具。传统的红外望远镜受限于空间分辨率，难以精确解析解离锋面的精细结构。随着詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）的投入使用，其卓越的中红外灵敏度和极高的空间分辨率使得天文学家能够前所未有地剖析PDRs复杂的激发机制与小尺度三维几何结构。
contribution: 本文利用JWST高分辨率观测了三个经典PDRs（Orion Bar、NGC7023和马头星云）的H2发射线，以约束解离锋面的物理结构。主要发现包括：1）各区域均呈现相似的纤维状形态，不同激发机制（热化与FUV泵浦）导致不同H2发射线间存在约0.5角秒的空间偏移；2）尽管三个区域的紫外辐射条件差异巨大，但H2转动激发显示出相似的高气体温度，这一现象对低激发态的马头星云而言颇为出乎意料；3）不同PDRs中的H2正仲比（OPR）有所不同，利用谱线估算的视向消光有效约束了三维几何与尘埃性质；4）受复杂的三维几何影响，H2发射完全被极薄的紫外照射层主导，因此它不能可靠地示踪PDR深层寒冷气体的温度，未来探究PDRs内部的温度与密度梯度必须结合其他分子示踪物。
summary: Molecular hydrogen (H2), the most abundant molecule in the interstellar medium, is a handy tool to study Photodissociation Regions. The JWST, with its high spatial resolution, sensitivity, and wavelength coverage, provides unique access to the detection and spatial morphology of the H2 rotational and rovibrational lines. Our goal is to analyze H2 line emission detected with JWST in several PDRs (the Orion Bar, NGC7023, and the Horsehead Nebula) to constrain the physical structure of dissociation front, and compare the impact of the ultraviolet field and the gas density across different regions. The analysis of H2 spatial morphology reveals similar filamentary structures across all regions. Spatial shifts between H2 lines (0.5") are observed and linked to differences in excitation mechanisms (thermalized vs FUV-pumped lines) and the temperature gradient. Despite differences in incident irradiation conditions, analysis of H2 rotational excitation yields high gas temperatures that are similar across the three PDRs. This is expected for a certain regime of excited PDRs (such as Orion and NGC7023), where the G0 at the DFs and the density are similar. However, it is surprising for less excited PDRs like the Horsehead Nebula. OPRs in the rotational and rovibrational levels differ across the three PDRs. We also used H2 rovibrational lines and the 0-0 S(3) line to estimate the visual extinction across the field of view, yielding markedly different results that constrain both the geometry and the grain composition. Due to the complex 3D geometry, H2 emission is observed throughout the FOV and is dominated by the thin UV illuminated layer, making H2 an unreliable tracer of gas temperature in deeper and coolers molecular layers of the PDR. Therefore, H2 emission is not sufficient to trace the possible temperature and density gradient across PDRs and must therefore be associated with other tracers.

title: Breaking the AGB Color Degeneracy with Variability and H$_2$O: A Consistent Picture of AGB Chemistry, Dust, and the J-Region Across Environments
background_knowledge: 渐近巨星分支（AGB）星是中小质量恒星演化的晚期阶段，以剧烈的恒星脉动、强烈的质量流失和星周尘埃形成为特征。根据大气中碳与氧的相对丰度，AGB星主要分为富氧（O-rich）和富碳（C-rich）两类。在观测上，天文学家常利用宽带测光颜色来区分它们，并将特定光度区间的AGB星（即J区AGB星，JAGB）作为测量近邻星系距离的标准烛光。然而，不同金属丰度环境下的尘埃产生效率不同，导致仅利用宽带颜色分类容易出现“简并”（不同类型的星呈现相似颜色）；同时，传统流体静力学恒星大气模型由于难以刻画脉动产生的扩展大气结构，往往无法准确预测诸如水分子（H2O）吸收等光谱特征。
contribution: 本文结合大麦哲伦云（LMC）的SPHEREx光谱数据与M101星系的JWST/HST测光及光变数据，将AGB星的光变、表面化学和星周尘埃置于统一的物理图像中。作者开发了对1.9微米H2O吸收敏感的F182M测光指数，成功打破了富氧与富碳AGB星在宽带颜色上的简并。研究证实恒星脉动引发了质量流失并被尘埃形成所放大，并发现：在高金属丰度的M101中，富氧AGB星由于硅酸盐尘埃生成效率更高，比LMC中的同类星显著更红，而富碳AGB星受环境影响较小。这一发现表明，直接套用LMC的颜色选择标准会在富金属环境中引入高达33-68%的富氧星污染，从而挑战了J区（JAGB）作为普适标准烛光的假设。作者建议综合利用光变（或红外过量）与分子特征测光，以大幅提升红外波段AGB星分类的准确性。
summary: Resolved asymptotic giant branch (AGB) populations present many observational puzzles. We consider three often treated separately: photometric C/O classification boundaries must be redrawn empirically in new environments; hydrostatic model grids are too blue in bands sampling H2O absorption; and J-region (JAGB) luminosities can differ between fields of a single galaxy. Pulsation connects them into a coherent picture. Using SPHEREx spectroscopy of AGB stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC) with JWST/NIRCam photometry and HST time-series of the SN Ia host M101, placed on a common scale by synthetic photometry, we investigate how AGB variability, surface chemistry, and circumstellar dust depend on environment. We develop an F182M index sensitive to 1.9$μ$m H2O absorption that chemically classifies variable AGB stars and reveals oxygen-rich (O-rich) stars degenerate with carbon-rich (C-rich) stars in broadband colors. Because these features arise in extended atmospheric layers, hydrostatic grids struggle to reproduce them. Pulsation and circumstellar dust are asymmetrically linked: nearly all stars with substantial infrared excess are variable, while many variables show little dust. This supports mass loss initiated by pulsation and enhanced by dust formation. Variable O-rich AGB stars in M101 are up to ~0.7 mag redder than their LMC counterparts in dust-sensitive colors, consistent with more efficient silicate-dust production at higher metallicity, while C-rich populations depend less on environment. Color windows that select C-rich stars cleanly in the LMC are therefore 33-68% O-rich in the metal-rich M101. This challenges the J-region's universality as a standard candle while evading standard self-consistency checks. We recommend combining variability, or the infrared excess that implies it, with photometry of molecular features to improve AGB classification at 0.75-5.0$μ$m.

title: Analyzing $μ$ Parameter Range and the Duration of Reheating in the Polynomial $α$-attractor Models using CMB Observations
background_knowledge: 宇宙暴胀理论是描述宇宙极早期演化的标准范式，它不仅解决了大爆炸宇宙学的平坦性和视界等疑难，还通过原初量子涨落为宇宙大尺度结构形成提供种子。α-吸引子（α-attractor）模型是一类重要的暴胀模型，其特点是能给出高度普适的观测预言（如标量光谱指数 n_s 和张量-标量比 r），且在领头阶近似下几乎不依赖于暴胀子势的具体形式。暴胀结束后，宇宙必须经历“重加热”（Reheating）阶段，将暴胀子的能量转化为标准模型粒子的热浴，从而过渡到热大爆炸时期。通过宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）对 n_s 和 r 等参数的高精度测量，可以有效限制暴胀模型及其重加热历史的演化细节。
contribution: 本文研究了多项式 α-吸引子模型中暴胀观测预言普适性的适用范围。作者推导了标量光谱指数 n_s 和张量-标量比 r 的扩展解析表达式，保留了超越常用普适近似的次级修正项，并发现这些修正使 n_s 显式依赖于多项式吸引子势的特征参数 μ。研究进一步引入了重加热持续时间及重加热期的有效状态方程参数，通过与当前 CMB 观测数据进行对比，确定了该模型可行的参数空间，并分析了模型参数 μ 与重加热过程的相互作用。结果表明，次级修正能够揭示多项式吸引子的底层物理结构，为在观测上区分该类模型中的不同子成员提供了可行途径。
summary: Cosmological $α$-attractor models are renowned for their universal predictions for inflationary observables, largely independent of the detailed form of the inflaton potential. In this work, we investigate the extent to which this universality persists for polynomial $α$-attractor models, with particular emphasis on the scalar spectral index ($n_s$) and the post-inflationary reheating history. We derive an extended analytical expression for the scalar spectral index ($n_s$) and the tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r$), retaining sub-leading contributions beyond the commonly used universal approximation. Interestingly, we find that these corrections introduce an explicit dependence of $n_s$ on the parameter characterizing the polynomial attractor potential $μ$, a dependence that is absent in the leading universal expression. We systematically investigate how this model dependence modifies the predictions in the $(n_s-r)$ plane and affects the model parameter ($μ$). We further incorporate the Duration of reheating ($ΔN_{rh}$) and effective equation of state parameter of the reheating epoch ($w_{rh}$), accounting for their impact on the number of e-folds between horizon crossing and the end of inflation ($ΔN_{\mathrm{CMB}}$). By confronting the resulting predictions with current CMB observations, we identify the viable parameter space and examine the interplay between the model parameter ($μ$) and reheating. Our results demonstrate that sub-leading corrections can provide a window into the underlying structure of polynomial attractors, offering a possible way to distinguish different members of the attractor class observationally.

title: Selective state space model for photon energy estimation in microwave kinetic inductance detectors
background_knowledge: 微波动态电感探测器（MKIDs）是一种用于天文观测的先进超导光子计数探测器，能够同时测量单个光子的能量和到达时间，且极易扩展为大型像素阵列（常用于紫外、光学和红外波段，即UVOIR）。传统上，从探测器信号中提取光子能量的标准算法是先进行坐标变换，随后应用维纳最优滤波器（Wiener optimal filter）。然而，该经典范式在数学上要求系统满足噪声平稳、响应线性以及脉冲形状与能量无关等假设，而MKIDs真实的物理响应机制却结构性地违背了这些假设，从而限制了其最终的能量分辨率（Resolving Power, R）。
contribution: 本文提出了一种名为 Venom 的选择性状态空间模型（基于 Mamba 架构），用于替代传统的坐标变换与最优滤波器，直接对原始同相/正交（IQ）时间序列数据进行光子能量估计。该模型极其轻量（仅3314个参数），专为在RFSoC读取硬件上部署而设计。通过在InHf和PtSi两组真实的MKID数据集上验证，Venom 显著提升了能量分辨率：在InHf双层谐振器上平均分辨率提升了5%（254 nm处R值达42.4，创下适用于阵列的UVOIR MKID最高记录）；在PtSi谐振器上平均分辨率大幅提升了66%，这不仅修正了传统滤波方法的潜在缺陷，还可能揭示了与光子吸收深度相关的脉冲形变新物理现象。
summary: Microwave Kinetic Inductance Detectors (MKIDs) are superconducting photon-counting detectors that measure the energy and arrival time of individual photons on large-format arrays. The standard energy estimator applies a coordinate transform followed by a Wiener optimal filter, optimal only for stationary noise, linear response, and energy-independent pulse shapes, assumptions that MKIDs structurally violate. We present Venom (Very Efficient Neural Optimal-filter for MKIDs), a selective state space model based on Mamba that replaces the coordinate transform and optimal filter with a single learned sequence model operating directly on raw in-phase/quadrature (IQ) timestream data. The model carries 3,314 trainable parameters and targets deployment on the MKIDGen3 RFSoC readout platform. We train on synthetic pulses drawn from a streaming-PCA plus shape-preserving (PCHIP) covariance interpolator built from calibration data, allowing continuous sampling of photon energy between calibration wavelengths. We validate Venom on two published MKID data sets: an InHf bilayer resonator at ten wavelengths from 254 to 1310 nm (Zobrist et al. 2022) and a PtSi resonator at five wavelengths from 808 to 1310 nm (Zobrist et al. 2019). All numbers are reported on a stratified 15% held-out validation set unseen by the model and synthetic-pulse generator during training. On InHf, Venom reaches a mean KDE resolving power of 26.1 versus 24.8 for the per-wavelength optimal-filter baseline, a 5% improvement. The R of 42.4 at 254 nm is the highest R ever recorded for a UVOIR MKID suitable for use in an array. On PtSi, Venom reaches a mean KDE R = 19.5 vs. R = 11.8 for the shared 920 nm template filter on the same held-out subset, a 66% improvement. This increase may reflect a fault with our previous optimal filtering approach on PtSi, or new physics related to pulse shape variations with photon absorption depth.

title: Architecture Acceleration of Machine Learning Gravitational Waveform Surrogate Models
background_knowledge: 引力波天文学的核心目标之一是探测并解析致密双星（如双黑洞、双中子星）的并合事件。为了从探测器的高噪声背景中提取微弱信号并进行物理参数估计（如质量、自旋、潮汐形变等），研究人员需要依赖高精度的理论引力波波形模板。然而，直接通过数值相对论或复杂的有效单体（EOB）方法求解波形面临巨大的计算成本。为此，天体物理学界发展了波形替代模型（Surrogate Models），近年来更是引入了机器学习技术来逼近这些高精度计算，以实现精度与速度的平衡。在引力波数据分析的贝叶斯推断（如MCMC或嵌套采样）过程中，往往需要数百万次的波形生成评估，波形计算的速度直接决定了参数估计的效率。利用现代张量计算框架和硬件加速器（如GPU）重构这些模型，是当前突破引力波数据分析计算瓶颈的重要研究范式。
contribution: 本研究在JAX生态系统中实现了机器学习引力波替代模型（mlgw与mlgw-bns）的可微与硬件加速版本。该框架支持JIT编译、向量并行化、原生GPU加速和自动微分功能。基准测试表明，在双黑洞（SEOBNRv5HM替代模型）与双中子星（TEOBResumSPA替代模型）的波形评估中，CPU上的计算速度比原版实现提升超一个数量级，而在GPU大规模批量计算加持下，速度提升达约两个数量级。通过结合GWgpu-jax和嵌套采样管道，该工作在单张GPU上仅耗时约12分钟和17分钟便分别完成了GW150914与GW170817的参数估计，且后验分布与LVK合作组的结果高度一致。此外，JAX的自动微分特性使得波形模型能够高效计算梯度和海森矩阵，为未来无缝集成基于梯度的贝叶斯推断方法奠定了基础。
summary: Accurate and computationally efficient waveform models of compact binary coalescences are a fundamental requirement for gravitational wave data analysis. This work presents differentiable and hardware-accelerated implementations of the machine-learning surrogate models mlgw and mlgw-bns within the JAX ecosystem. The proposed framework enables JIT compilation, vector paralellization, native GPU acceleration, and automatic differentiation, while preserving the original surrogate training infrastructure and its applicability to arbitrary non-precessing waveform approximants. Benchmarks are performed in the binary black hole case with a newly trained surrogate of the SEOBNRv5HM approximant; on CPU, they show speed-ups in waveform evaluation time with respect to the original mlgw implementation that exceed one order of magnitude; further, when exploiting GPU acceleration and large-batch vectorization these reach approximately two orders of magnitude. The benchmarks performed in the case of binary neutron stars with a TEOBResumSPA surrogate model achieve similar gains on GPU. Our JAX-based surrogate modeling framework can be integrated into Bayesian parameter estimation pipelines through GWgpu-jax, an open-source package that connects JAX-compatible gravitational waveform generators to JAX-native sampling algorithms. We demonstrate this capability with a nested-sampling pipeline built upon BlackJax-NS, performing parameter estimation analyses of the GW150914 and GW170817 events with mlgw and mlgw-bns. The analyses require approximately twelve and seventeen minutes, respectively, on a single GPU and yield posterior distributions consistent with those reported by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration. Beyond nested sampling, JAX automatic differentiation provides efficient gradient and Hessian evaluations of the waveform models, enabling integration with gradient-based Bayesian inference methods.

title: Beating and coupling in pulsating stars: a unified Fourier description and observational diagnostics
background_knowledge: 脉动变星（如天琴座RR型变星、大振幅盾牌座δ型变星等）会因恒星外层大气的周期性膨胀和收缩而产生规律的亮度变化。天文学家通常利用傅里叶变换对这些变星的光变曲线进行频率分析。在理想情况下，纯粹的周期性脉动会在傅里叶频谱中表现为主频率及其谐波。然而，实际观测中许多脉动变星会展现出长期的振幅或相位变化（例如著名的布拉什科效应），这会在频谱的主频附近产生旁瓣或多重峰。这些复杂的频谱结构可能源于三种不同的物理机制：物理调制、相近频率振荡的线性拍频（Beating）效应，以及不同振荡模式之间的非线性耦合。由于这些机制产生的频谱特征往往相互重叠，如何在观测上对它们进行有效区分，一直是星震学和变星物理学中的重要难题。
contribution: 本文建立了一个统一的解析傅里叶描述框架，用于区分脉动变星光变曲线中的物理调制、线性拍频和非线性耦合效应。作者通过将信号表示为非正弦主振荡与相邻次级振荡的组合，解析推导了由线性叠加、二次耦合及一般非线性耦合所产生的频率、复振幅和相位特征，并利用人工光变曲线对计算现象进行了阐释。此外，作者开发并实现了一个名为“freqdiag”的诊断工具，通过复振幅拟合和旁瓣振幅级数层次测试来比较调制模型与耦合模型。该研究明确了区分这些机制的观测判据，为解释类布拉什科RRc变星、HADS变星等复杂脉动变星提供了一套实用的分析框架。
summary: Long-term amplitude and phase variations in pulsating stars produce side peaks or multiplets in the Fourier spectrum of the light curves around the pulsation frequency and its harmonics. Such structures are often attributed to modulation, although linear beating and the non-linear coupling of close oscillations can also produce similar patterns. We develop a unified analytical Fourier description of these alternatives and identify observational relations that retain discriminatory power when their frequency patterns overlap. We represent the signal as a dominant, non-sinusoidal oscillation plus one or more secondary oscillations close to it, and analytically derive the frequencies, complex amplitudes, and phases resulting from linear superposition, quadratic and general non-linear coupling. We also illustrate the calculated phenomena using artificial light curves. We implement the resulting tests in a diagnostic tool "freqdiag", which compares modulation with primary--secondary quadratic coupling models anchored to either the higher- or lower-frequency side peak, using the same normalized complex amplitudes, and supplements the fit with hierarchical tests of side-peak amplitude progression. A sinusoidal secondary signal produces only one additional peak in the linear-beating case, whereas a non-sinusoidal secondary signal produces a harmonic sequence, whose separation from the primary harmonics increases with order. Quadratic coupling produces terms $nf_0+lf_B$, but their amplitudes and phases follow shifted-harmonic and combination relations. At general non-linear order, coupling and modulation occupy the same frequency grid. The formalism provides a practical framework for interpreting Blazhko-like RRc stars, HADS variables, and other pulsating stars in which modulation and coupling are difficult to separate observationally.

title: Hidden in the Halo: New Diffuse Star Clusters in the M82 Starburst with JWST
background_knowledge: 在星系晕中，除了典型的球状星团（Globular Clusters, 尺寸通常为2-3秒差距）和矮星系之外，还存在一类被称为弥漫星团（Diffuse Star Clusters, DSCs）的天体。它们在‘尺寸-光度图’上占据了球状星团与矮星系之间研究较少的过渡区域。由于这类天体表面亮度极低，过去的观测设备很难探测并辨认它们。然而，随着詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）等具备极高空间分辨率和近红外灵敏度设备的运行，天文学家如今能够直接解析近邻星系（如M82这样的近邻星暴星系）中的单颗恒星。通过拟合色星等图（CMD）和辐射轮廓，研究人员可以精确测量这些暗弱系统的年龄、金属丰度及物理尺寸，从而探讨星团与超暗弱矮星系之间的物理边界及演化关联。
contribution: 本研究利用JWST/NIRCam的存档图像，在近邻星暴星系M82的星系晕中发现了4个新的暗弱弥漫星团（DSCs）。研究成功解析了这四个系统中的单颗恒星，基于等相线模型对比显示它们均以古老（约100亿年）的恒星族群为主。其中DSC 1为贫金属星团（[M/H]~-2），其余三个金属丰度约为[M/H]~-0.8。测定结果表明这些星团的尺寸介于5.4至10.5秒差距之间（比典型球状星团更延展），且光度极低（M_V约为-4.1至-6.4等），比已知M82星团暗约1个星等。尤其是最暗的DSC 3，其性质已接近银河系的超暗弱致密伴星系。这些仅靠目视检查就发现的暗弱目标表明，目前的星团星表中极有可能严重低估了此类天体的数量，利用JWST深场存档数据在近邻星系中继续搜寻将具有巨大的科学潜力。
summary: Diffuse star clusters (DSCs) occupy a poorly explored region of the size-luminosity plane between classical globular clusters (GCs) and dwarf galaxies. Here we report the discovery of four faint DSCs in the halo of the nearby starburst galaxy M82 using archival JWST/NIRCam imaging. We resolve individual stars in all four systems, whose color-magnitude diagrams are consistent with predominantly old ($\sim10$ Gyr) stellar populations, based on comparison with isochrones. DSC 1 hosts a metal-poor population ($[\mathrm{M/H}]\sim-2$), while DSCs 2, 3 and 4 are better represented by $[\mathrm{M/H}]\sim-0.8$ isochrones. To establish their nature, we measure their sizes and integrated magnitudes using curve-of-growth and radial profile fits, which yield consistent results between these methods. The sizes of DSCs range from $\sim$ 5.4 to 10.5 pc, making them more extended than typical GCs (2-3 pc). Their luminosities span M$_{\rm V}\simeq-4.1$ to $-6.4$, reaching $\sim$ 1 mag fainter than the previously known M82 star cluster (SC) population. At these low luminosities, the systems occupy a sparsely sampled region of the size-luminosity plane where the distinction between SCs and dwarf galaxies becomes increasingly ambiguous. Most notably, DSC 3 is the faintest SC candidate identified in M82 to date and approaches the regime occupied by Milky Way ultra-faint compact satellites. These faint DSCs were identified through visual inspection alone, suggesting they are likely underrepresented in existing star cluster catalogs, and that a JWST-based archival search of nearby galaxies would be fruitful.

title: Evidence for the Typhon Stellar Stream as the Remnant of a Recently-disrupted Dwarf Galaxy
background_knowledge: 在现代宇宙学的冷暗物质（ΛCDM）层级结构形成模型中，类似银河系的大型星系是通过不断吸积和并合较小的矮星系而逐渐生长的。这些被吸积的矮星系或球状星团在银河系强大潮汐力的作用下会被逐渐撕裂瓦解，在星系晕中留下长条状的恒星遗迹，被称为‘恒星星流’（Stellar Stream）。恒星星流是追踪星系吸积历史和探测暗物质晕分布的绝佳探针。在观测上，区分星流的前身天体究竟是矮星系还是球状星团的一个核心指标是其化学丰度的弥散度：球状星团通常由几乎同时形成的单一恒星族群组成，因此金属丰度高度一致；而矮星系拥有自身的暗物质晕，能够束缚气体并经历复杂的恒星形成历史，导致其成员星必然表现出显著的金属丰度弥散（Metallicity Dispersion）。
contribution: 本研究结合了Gaia空间望远镜的天体测量数据与现有巡天的光谱数据，对近期发现的Typhon恒星星流进行了全面的化学与动力学分析。研究团队新证认了107颗候选成员星，将星流的已知探测范围延伸至67 kpc，证实了其巨大的远银心距。光谱数据分析得出该星流的平均金属丰度为[Fe/H]=-1.42，且存在高达0.26 dex的金属丰度弥散，这确凿地证明了Typhon的前身天体是一个恒星质量在10^6至10^7太阳质量之间的矮星系，而非球状星团。此外，该星流展现出极高的轨道偏心率（e ≳ 0.85）和高轨道能量，表明它源于一次较近期的矮星系吸积与彻底瓦解事件。研究由此提出推测：处于高偏心率轨道并合的矮星系星流，其彻底溶解的速度远快于圆轨道星流。
summary: In the hierarchical model of galaxy formation, the Milky Way's stellar halo assembles through the successive accretion of dwarf galaxies. While many resulting substructures have been identified, the origin of the recently discovered Typhon stellar stream remains ambiguous, as dynamical data alone are insufficient to distinguish between a globular cluster and a dwarf galaxy progenitor.
